strings.OMS_local_defence_project_desc:
Finally, we have swept away the numerous traitors and separatists from the Russian land. The Black League has truly proven to all of Russia that we are worthy of leading her to meet the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.

Though the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will inevitably arrive, if our preparations are inadequate, allowing the Western demons and jackals to set foot upon our soil, the Russian land will be ravaged before the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is complete. According to the assessment of many high-ranking operatives of the Black League, though we have unified the Russian land, Russia is currently in a state of chaos. The administrative, financial, and military systems of various regions are disparate. The people temporarily submit to our guns, but they do not truly identify with our great cause of rejuvenation. In many newly ruled territories, we have yet to establish complete control. Numerous bandits and resistance forces would rather identify with the Teutonic beasts of the West or the failed Bolsheviks than with us. If we were to face the imminent invasion or initiate the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial in our current state, we would collapse before our enemies.

Therefore, £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Commander-in-Chief Yazov believes that before embarking on the true £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we must make more thorough preparations. The first step is to build up our Russian homeland. We will establish a more centralized and unified system, forging the entirety of Russia into an iron furnace, coalescing the hearts of our people and preparing to annihilate the Western beasts on our own soil.
strings.OMS_leagcy_of_siberian_plan_desc:
Undoubtedly, Bukharin is the greatest traitor and coward in Russian history. He allowed the great Mother Russia to fall into the hands of Teutonic demons, causing the deaths of countless Russian sons and daughters. But objectively speaking, this traitor did leave behind something trivial for Russia: the Siberian Construction Plan. This plan developed the desolate Siberia to a certain extent. Before our unification of Russia, this plan also saw some development at the hands of other separatist forces. Although these fools wasted too much development efficiency, after eliminating them, we still acquired a considerable industrial fortune.

After evaluation, our Minister of Economy has made his ruling: we will retain the relevant facilities and resources in the local area that have full construction potential. The rest will be completely dismantled and transported to the locations planned for the future £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial for more efficient construction and utilization. All these industrial legacies will lay the foundation for the cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, transforming into every bullet and every shell that will destroy the enemy.
strings.OMS_redefine_the_resource_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial requires innumerable resources. Iron, oil, aluminum—all are extremely valuable to our war industry. But our enemies will not wait for us to slowly develop these resources to destroy them; they are bound to invade us. We absolutely cannot let these precious resources fall into enemy hands before they are developed. We must further accelerate the development of domestic resources.

We have wasted too much time, and our own industrial development capacity is insufficient. But we still have a way to compensate: people. The Russian land has no shortage of manpower. For the cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we will exhaust everything and throw it into industry and resources. Without enough machinery, we will conscript operatives, prisoners, and others to throw into the mines. Without enough blast furnaces, we will use numerous small-scale facilities as replacements. For the sake of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, every exploitable resource must be properly utilized.
strings.OMS_repair_the_old_thing_desc:
The era of the old Soviet Union was once Russia's most glorious moment, with its industry at the forefront of Europe, thousands upon thousands of industrial facilities, and knowledgeable industrial talents. But these things were all destroyed by the invading Western Nazis. These demons destroyed everything, leaving us with only dilapidated machinery, the ruins of our homes, and a populace ignorant and benighted. These are the blood debts owed by the German bandits to the Russian people, and we will collect them all.

Although the Nazi beasts wrought much destruction, the resilient Russian people did their best to preserve numerous resources from the Soviet era: machinery buried underground, unfinished research results in institutes, and personnel training manuals. We must organize and repair these artifacts left from the Soviet era as much as possible, creating the conditions for our vengeance against the Western beasts.
strings.OMS_militarize_the_industry_desc:
The cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial requires thousands upon thousands of weapons. From thermonuclear bombs, missiles, and aircraft down to the rifles, communication devices, and support artillery used by our soldiers, all of these demand a powerful industry for production. Our industry must be capable of supporting our troops from West Russia, providing sufficient arms and ammunition for our soldiers and operatives along a front of thousands of kilometers, enabling them to engage in prolonged combat with the Western foes, and destroying everything of the enemy with overwhelming firepower until they are utterly annihilated.

To achieve all this, we must make our industrial system operate even more efficiently, becoming a great furnace that melts down the strength of the entire nation. The entire industrial system must undergo comprehensive optimization. Our government departments will operate at full capacity, transforming our industrial system to serve the sacred cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. Superfluous considerations like profit and developmental needs will be discarded. All efforts must be directed towards the ultimate goal of militarized production, until the sacred objective of wiping out the Teutonic bandits is accomplished.
strings.OMS_resettle_the_pop_desc: In the plan for the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we will begin in the Moscow region and launch a series of attacks across all of Eastern Europe, all the way to the Nazi homeland. From fuel-air explosives and biological weapons to chemical weapons, we will unleash every weapon of mass destruction upon their lands, destroying everything they hold dear. But it is certain that, given the deranged nature of the Teutonic beasts, they will retaliate with equal bombing on our lands. Our soil will suffer the same devastation. War is a test of endurance, and we must be more capable of survival than the beasts to truly transcend death. The final stage of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is when our people can emerge from their bunkers and utterly strangle the Western beasts within their cages. To this end, we will relocate the populations of all major and medium-sized cities near the border. They will be moved to the Siberian region, the final bastion for the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, where they will settle and become the last force to kill the Western beasts.
strings.OMS_the_russia_city_desc:
In the plans of our brightest minds, the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, this war of national vengeance, will inevitably escalate into a thermonuclear war. For the great Russian people to survive this apocalyptic conflict, we must build the sturdiest of fortresses, allowing our people to survive until vengeance is served, and to emerge from the wasteland in the best possible condition after the apocalypse to complete the final phase of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial: to kill all Germans.

Fortunately, in preparing for a possible Teutonic invasion, we have already undertaken a series of underground city shelter network projects in the Omsk region. Through these constructions, we have gained much experience and learned many lessons. We will invest a huge sum to transform all designated survival cities. We do not just need one Omsk; we need the entire nation to become Omsk.
strings.OMS_will_bulit_by_steel_and_gears_desc:
Before the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial descends, Russia must become strong enough not to be intimidated by enemy pressure, not to be easily destroyed by their weapons. To achieve this, sufficient urban construction is essential. But at present, our operatives and people are required to work long, arduous hours every day. The string of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is already stretched too tight for them. We cannot let it snap; instead, we must make them learn to adapt and become accustomed to it.

The survival of Russia's men, women, and children depends on the success or failure of this urban construction. We will further develop city-related construction, providing posts for our people and operatives. In their work, they will learn what discipline is, what strength is, and thereby contribute to the cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, becoming a part of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial itself.
strings.OMS_and_the_clocks_will_be_punctual_desc:
As the urban construction work we have undertaken progresses, the great cause of national rejuvenation has finally found new vitality. Through the deepening of urban construction and the investment of vast living resources, the discontent of operatives and soldiers has been gradually suppressed. Through long-term disciplinary education, they have learned to mesh together like gears. The League has also launched a series of propaganda campaigns. Under our combined efforts, our production efficiency has reached a new high, and their fear of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is further receding.

The countdown to Judgment Day is gradually approaching, and we are methodically pushing it forward.
strings.OMS_expand_the_potemkin_desc:
When we were still a regional power, our £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Commander-in-Chief Yazov and Foreign Minister Aleksandr Sakharovsky ingeniously proposed Operation Potemkin, a scheme of deceptive propaganda to secure foreign aid. This operation allowed us to obtain substantial development resources from the Americans and Japanese, these potential sinners. This plan was expanded multiple times and achieved rich results. While those scum were priding themselves on their supposed benevolence and self-interest, we were already reaping a harvest of precious resources, which became crucial for our recovery of the Russian land.

But now, we are the masters of the entire Russian land. For the sake of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we need to further expand our military, but this will inevitably conflict with our previously promoted image of 'beating swords into plowshares.' They will gradually withdraw their support, and may even pry into our affairs, threatening the smooth progress of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. Therefore, we must further expand Operation Potemkin. We will conduct targeted research on different foreign groups, tailoring our propaganda to their views and interests, to make these fools of the Western world once again open their purses for us.

When the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial descends, we will grant them a less painful death.
strings.OMS_foreigns_arent_know_at_all_desc:
Ever since we unified the Russian land, the outside world's probing has become relentless. Immigrants, journalists, industrial teams, returning émigrés, and even spies parachuting into our country to spy. The Nazi militarists are desperate for any intelligence that suggests we are a threat, to incite their populace for another invasion. The Western degenerates seek to tear down our perfect image for their own selfish gain. Even some of their domestic pacifists, trying to avoid conflict with the Teutons, attempt to expose us to halt aid.

None of them will succeed. Our intelligence and diplomatic departments will act, launching comprehensive operations both at home and abroad. Societal surveillance and registration will uncover the tracks of hidden spies. Large-scale external propaganda work will continue to be pushed forward. Those weaklings will be bogged down by endless disputes until they finally shut up.

Russia will become a prosperous and strong bastion of democracy in the world, unceasingly striving against Nazism.

Until the final curtain of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.
strings.OMS_but_we_knows_everything_desc:
In the years past, to ensure the smooth advance of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we initiated illegal immigration work in many key regions. From Moskowien to Poland, from America to Europe, a large number of illegal Russian immigrants have settled abroad. On the surface, they hold different identities, from lawyers to workers, from slaves to tenant farmers. They have established various forces in overseas Russian communities under different guises, forming webs of overseas intelligence that have silenced many Russian émigré communities.

Now is another opportune moment to put them to use. Before the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial begins, we will mobilize all our illegal immigrants to carry out relevant activities. Immigrants in Europe must actively provide intelligence to aid the march on Berlin. Illegal immigrants in the Americas and other regions must actively build momentum and, as much as possible, sow confusion to ensure that other world powers remain on the sidelines for a prolonged period after the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial has begun.
strings.OMS_their_technologys_desc:
The failure of the First Trial left our country to languish in division for far too long. After the Black League defeated one traitor and coward after another, we look out to see that Russia's industry has fallen completely behind many nations of the world. Once a leading industrial power in Europe, we are now at one of the most backward levels globally. Intelligence from both diplomatic and covert channels indicates that, let alone the American and Japanese degenerates we might face, even when compared to the Western Nazi beasts we are bound to confront, our current industrial equipment level is inferior even to their puppet states, their so-called equal allies, and even their Reichskommissariats. This is extremely detrimental to our cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.

£GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Commander-in-Chief Yazov has formally ordered that the Ministry of National Development will coordinate with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Based on the needs of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we will acquire the necessary industrial equipment. What can be bought, we will find a way to buy. What cannot be bought, we will find a way to steal or seize. We must make those advanced pieces of equipment fully serve our £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. If we cannot have them, then we will destroy them.
strings.OMS_and_their_skills_desc:
Even with advanced equipment, we still have to overcome the problem of insufficient industrial knowledge. One of the disastrous consequences of being defeated by the Teutons twice is that Russia has plunged into darkness in terms of education. At least one generation lost their rightful access to education after the invasion, and the years of national division have prolonged this outcome, directly creating more than a generation of illiterates in our land. Even though the Black League has exerted all its strength, sweeping away weakness and corruption with a decade of force and rescuing Russia from darkness, the bitter fruit has already been sown. The Russian land cannot afford to spend another decade catching up.

To be worthy of the final showdown with the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Greater Germanic Reich, we must learn to overtake on the corners. The intelligence network and illegal immigrant organizations established abroad will now be put to use. We will 'sincerely' invite those workers with technical skills to come to our land and help us build Russia. We will use various methods to extract their skills and make relevant summaries for our future cause.

If they are unwilling, then occasional disappearances will be quite normal.
strings.OMS_will_service_for_us_desc:
In fact, it is not just industry that we can utilize. According to targeted research by the Ministry of National Development, whether it be the Western degenerates or the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Greater Germanic Reich—the ultimate mortal enemy of the Russian people—they have created many novel and advanced things over the years. To ensure profits, they have patented all these things and then used these so-called patents to gain benefits, while incidentally promoting the so-called virtues of law-abiding behavior.

But we are not bound by these things. In the coming years, we will carry out replication and reverse-engineering work on everything we need. We will learn how to produce and manufacture them. All these things will be used in the upcoming cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. We need not abide by the laws of those degenerates. Under the flames of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, all are equal.
strings.OMS_a_new_siberian_plan_desc:
In the years past, to defeat the various rebel bandits and dissenters on our soil, we launched a series of comprehensive development plans in the West Siberian region. These plans, encompassing industry, agriculture, transportation, and resources, allowed us to achieve rapid leaps forward in a short period, pushing forward the modernization of the Black League's education and research. It was with this power that we defeated one formidable enemy after another, leading the Russian land from darkness into light.

But for the upcoming cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, West Siberia alone is far from sufficient. The reconstruction of Russia must be put on the agenda immediately. We will use the experience gained from construction in West Siberia to popularize our development experience throughout Russia, especially in Central Siberia and the Far East. Whether it is resource development or production research, all need comprehensive modernization. Only then can the brave warriors of the Black League be prepared for anything, overcome all difficulties, and save Russia from fire and water.
strings.OMS_central_siberian_development_desc:
Central Siberia was once a priority development area in the Bukharin era. At that time, the leaders of the old Soviet Union hoped to use Central Siberia as a preparatory development base to deal with a possible Western invasion. However, for the sake of so-called stability and unity, they tolerated numerous non-patriots and profit-seeking factory owners to lead the development of this region. This led to a chaotic Central Siberian development plan, producing an excess of non-essential luxury goods that were of no help to the national defense, instead of the steel and weapons the country needed. This is what led to the motherland's defeat at the hands of the Nazi beasts, and the Russian land falling into darkness.

Now, we will lead the development of this region. First, we will re-furbish and re-plan the facilities in this area to integrate them into our industrial development system. Subsequently, we will implement comprehensive industrial nationalization and militarization. The entire industry of Central Siberia will be incorporated into the cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. The essence of Russia will truly be able to serve the great cause of the New Russia's revenge, rather than individual selfish desires.
strings.OMS_most_effectiveness_way_desc:
The great cause of national revenge is inseparable from the army under the command of the Black League. They were the vanguard that saved Russia in our darkest times, bringing justice and strength to Russia. But in the process of saving Russia, the army has already paid too high a price—in the railway system, industry, scientific research, and national fortress construction. Our army has participated in and led too much. Although we have been expanding our forces, there is now a gap in the army's effective strength, and a new round of investment is necessary.

After discussions, £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Commander-in-Chief Yazov has issued an order. The League will provide more financial investment for army development. These funds will be used not only to expand the number of troops but also for the comprehensive development of the Black League's army. Whether it is improving the army's organizational structure, accelerating the realization of army communication down to the squad level, support firepower to the platoon level, and a series of weapon and equipment constructions—from weapons to organization, from discipline to training, the army of the Black League will be improved in all aspects.
strings.OMS_far_eastern_development_desc:
The Far East has always been the most impoverished and difficult region for Russia's development. All who came before us paid little attention to its construction. If it weren't for the war, we wouldn't develop it much either.

But under the objective of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, the Far East has taken on a new significance. This region is remote and backward; its long-term lack of development means that the major powers' assessment of its value is extremely low. The enemy's threat assessment of us will not prioritize this area, and this is precisely our opportunity.

During the execution of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, many important cities on Russian soil will be prioritized for attack by the enemy's atomic weapons. Although we have already built countless bunkers to withstand the atomic flames, this is far from enough. To preserve more Russians to survive the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, the development of the Far East will be put on the agenda. The enemy will never imagine that we will hide in a place they would not expect, and that after the atomic flames have burned out, we will be able to emerge from the bunkers to complete the final order of judgment.
strings.OMS_use_every_things_desc:
All of Russia's people are contributing everything to the sacred cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, and our industry will be no exception. For a long time, the further development of Siberian industry has been constrained by our country's backward power system. After the First Trial, Russia was long in a state of division and anarchy. The various separatists only knew how to exploit, not to build and maintain. Our industry has long been using the old Soviet-era power grid. The shortage of industrial knowledge has even led to insufficient maintenance of the power system. This has directly caused Siberian industrial development, which could have been further advanced, to be halted due to objective limitations.

The transformation of Siberian industry will be further carried out. We will mobilize numerous citizens and industrial operatives to participate in the renovation of the Siberian industrial system, utilizing everything we can. We will comprehensively transform and build the industrial and supporting facilities of the Siberian region, so that Siberian industry can break free from the shackles of the old days and quickly enter modernization.
strings.OMS_ghost_in_the_shadow_desc:
The threats we face come not only from the Western beasts, but also from domestic reactionary enemies. External enemies are trying to find the location of our foreign trade, while those revisionists and corrupt elements within are trying to hide in our ranks, affecting the production activities of our workers and operatives for the cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. To overthrow us, they would even sell their souls to cooperate with those damn Nazi beasts and Western degenerates, selling out our factory locations in exchange for so-called money and better collaborator positions. They must be completely annihilated, from body to soul.

Mere annihilation is not enough. We must establish a more rigorous surveillance system. To ensure the safe conduct of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, a special infiltration project will be launched. We will further expand our agent system nationwide. The activities of all factory departments will be recorded. Every secret of our people and operatives must be known to us.
strings.OMS_darkness_in_the_world_desc:
The flames of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will consume all things, but we can control where these flames fall. Through our relentless intelligence infiltration of the Western beasts, we know that their designated targets are not only our cities, but also our numerous factories. Once the war begins, to stop us from upholding justice, they will surely prioritize striking our industry, preventing our factories from providing sufficient weapons for the brave soldiers of the Black League, letting our people freeze and starve to death as in the past.

To prevent this, the best method is to hide our factories. Under the national defense plan, we have already established a comprehensive system of bunkers and shelters in many areas across the country. Next, we must connect our production departments with these systems. We will build the world's largest underground transportation line through these pervasive shelters, while simultaneously establishing camouflaged industrial, air defense, and counter-espionage systems to mislead our enemies into pointless attacks. When they drop their precious bombs on our fake production lines, our true production capacity will be preserved, continuing to operate efficiently for the League's righteous war.
strings.OMS_hearts_of_war_desc: The development of all things requires strong leadership, just as the human body cannot be without a heart. It is because Russia has the iron-like heart of the Black League that it has been able to transcend degeneracy and vulgarity. The same applies to the military-industrial complex. In the report submitted by the Ministry of National Development, although the numerous industries in Central Siberia are productive, they lack the leadership of strong industrial enterprises after unification and have failed to adapt to modern assembly line production models, resulting in lower efficiency than in the past. Historically, we have had no shortage of such powerful industrial enterprises. The numerous military production enterprises of the old Soviet era produced countless military products during the period of Russian unification. After the country was unified, they were temporarily set aside for various reasons. But now, with the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial approaching, we will re-mobilize these powerful industrial enterprises, and with them as our lead, conduct comprehensive war preparations and construction.
strings.OMS_humans_are_gears_desc:
Although the Black League has done its utmost to build the motherland, an undeniable reality is that we are still unable to overcome the natural deficiencies of the Far East. Our railway transport system has been stretched to its limit for the cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. Maintaining industrial operations in the Far East is already its limit. To attempt a complete development and construction of the Far East would inevitably delay the meticulously planned £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.

Therefore, after a vote, the committee members of the Black League have unanimously agreed to a large-scale conscription of manpower from the Far East region for industrial construction. All prisoners captured in the Far East will begin labor on the spot. Industrial operatives and soldiers in the Far East region must also participate, reviving the leading industries of the old Soviet era, to overcome the difficulties of nature with human strength.
strings.OMS_atomic_hearts_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is no dinner party, but the final, mortal struggle between the Teutonic and Russian nations. To achieve victory in this war of national rejuvenation, our military officers have conducted a series of wargames. All results point to one reality: whether we or the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Greater Germanic Reich instigates the war, those Nazi pigs will first throw their atomic bombs at us. And those Western degenerates will not immediately begin mutual annihilation; their cowardly nature dictates that they will watch us be destroyed.

To prevent this possibility, we must possess sufficient capacity for mutual destruction. The previously formulated plan to only destroy the Teutonic barbarians is far from enough. We must further expand the production scale and delivery capabilities of our atomic weapons. We must not only be able to destroy the Nazis, but also launch our nuclear weapons at America, at Japan. All sinners shall bear the wrath of our vengeance. Before the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, all are equal.
strings.OMS_research_minuteman_technology_desc:
Times are changing, technology is advancing. As the Black League catches up with the world's leading technology, the field of anti-missile defense in the military domain has undergone significant changes. The interception rate of traditional short- and medium-range missiles is gradually increasing. The survival rate of strategic bombers flying directly over a country for a full-scale bombing is progressively decreasing. Our Western enemies now possess countless anti-missile systems we have never heard of. Our autonomously developed short- and medium-range missiles and weapons alone are incapable of directly destroying the major cities of the Nazis.

Through the operations of our secret intelligence department, we have acquired the 'Minuteman' intercontinental ballistic missile, developed and deployed by the United States in the 1960s. These meteors, capable of flying out of the atmosphere, possess a power we can hardly imagine. We will conduct comprehensive research and replication of it, to develop our own celestial meteors, so that they may break through the protection of the Teutonic beasts and pierce the heart of Nazism.
strings.OMS_death_hand_system_desc:
In studying the entire process of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, a question was repeatedly posed to the members of the Black League: the inhuman Nazis possess nuclear weapons capable of destroying the entire globe. Once they decide to launch a nuclear surprise attack, throwing most of their atomic weapons at Russia simultaneously, our high command is at risk of being annihilated. Although we have built sufficient bunkers to cope with this, if our high command is destroyed in a nuclear attack, our counterattack will lack a brain. If the counterattack is not timely, our nuclear retaliation will not trigger a worldwide chain of nuclear devastation, and all our efforts will be in vain.

Therefore, we must be able to establish a weapon system that can continue to trigger a nuclear counterattack even after our high command is gone. After discussions with our scientists, this system will be named the 'Perimeter' system, with its operational name being 'Dead Hand.' This system will automatically monitor communication with our high command. Once the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial officially begins, if this system does not detect our response, it will automatically register that our high command has been destroyed in a Nazi nuclear attack and launch all our pre-prepared nuclear weapons, completing the plan of destruction we have prepared.
strings.OMS_trident_and_northernstar_desc:
In today's doctrine of global nuclear strikes, in addition to the specific use of land-based nuclear weapons, sea-based nuclear strikes are also an indispensable part. For our prepared cause of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, to block our path of vengeance, the Nazis will surely deploy concentrated defenses along all border areas with us. But the weakness of our navy is known to all; they will certainly neglect this, and this will be our key to a breakthrough.

Through the excellent work of our agents, we have successfully obtained key data on the Trident and Polaris sea-based missiles researched by the Nazis and the Americans in past years. These submarine-launched missiles can be fired from underwater submarines. What we need to do is to comprehensively replicate these things and equip them with nuclear warheads. Our enemies have more and vaster seas than we do; they cannot possibly watch every piece of it. As long as our forces can evade their eyes, from a place they cannot see, the sword from the sea will rise to the heavens, letting the Teutonic barbarians understand what it means for death to descend from the sky!
strings.OMS_atomic_powers_desc: In the Atomic Age, love is madness. After the curtain of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is formally raised, our nuclear attack on the Western beasts will also begin. At the start, we will launch small, less powerful atomic weapons to attack, consuming the defensive strength of the Nazis. After their defenses have slackened, what we must do is launch more and more powerful nuclear weapons onto Nazi soil, further consuming and destroying their defensive forces, helping the brave warriors of the Black League advance towards Berlin. To achieve this strategic objective, we must build more and denser atomic weapon and weapon bases. We must make the sky over the entire £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Greater Germanic Reich be filled with the dust of nuclear weapons, so they will never have a tomorrow.
strings.OMS_mission_completed_desc:
The road to the rejuvenation of the Russian nation is bound to be a rugged one. On this path, we have overcome the corruption and lassitude of the old days, swept away numerous divisive and rebellious forces, and awakened the deep-seated sources of vengeance and strength in the hearts of the Russian people. Even after unifying Russia, we have not become complacent, but have undertaken even more work. From industry to intelligence, from defensive bunkers to offensive nuclear weapons, we have persisted, all to personally bring down the final fires of vengeful judgment.

But for now, we have done very well. The defense of our homeland has proceeded smoothly under our methodical work. It can be said that no one could do better than we have done now.

Now, let's take a good rest. Tomorrow's £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will require the redoubled efforts of every one of us.
strings.OMS_local_defence_project_tt: £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Commander-in-Chief Yazov believes that more thorough preparations are needed before the Great Trial.
strings.OMS_leagcy_of_siberian_plan_tt: The Siberian Plan has left us a considerable legacy. We must make full use of it to prepare for the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.
strings.OMS_redefine_the_resource_tt: For the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, every drop of oil, every gram of resource is precious.
strings.OMS_repair_the_old_thing_tt: The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is the final war our nation will face. We will give it our all.
strings.OMS_militarize_the_industry_tt: £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon The Great Enemy is at the gates! Everyone must devote themselves to the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. All is for efficiency.
strings.OMS_resettle_the_pop_tt: The population is a part of our resources. As such, we must make full use of the population. £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Everything serves the Great Trial.
strings.OMS_the_russia_city_tt: Omsk is the model for all our cities. We must rebuild every city. £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Everything serves the Great Trial.

You have no other choice.
 £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon The Great Trial is supreme.
strings.OMS_and_the_clocks_will_be_punctual_tt: The city is orderly. The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial requires countless resources, and we have the most efficient way to produce them.

strings.OMS_foreigns_arent_know_at_all_tt: We are the only nation of shadows in the world. No news can possibly get out.
strings.OMS_but_we_knows_everything_tt: We know all, we are omniscient. £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon The Great Trial is eternal.
strings.OMS_their_technologys_tt:
Even with our utmost effort, our own capabilities are still too weak. Sometimes, we must look to other places. Their technology is of some use to us.
 £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon The Great Trial is supreme.

Time is too short, far too short. We must use our intelligence network to rapidly enhance our own industrial level.
 £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon The Great Trial is supreme.
strings.OMS_will_service_for_us_tt: Our actions are beginning to show results.

We need to quickly draft and implement a new Siberian plan.
Everything serves the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.
strings.OMS_central_siberian_development_effect_: £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Commander-in-Chief Yazov believes that the development of Central Siberia will be highly beneficial.
strings.OMS_most_effectiveness_way_tt: The simplest way to increase combat effectiveness is £Gmore funding.
strings.OMS_far_eastern_development_effect_tt: The development of the Far East will be beneficial for us to emerge from the bunkers after the war.
strings.OMS_use_every_things_tt: The old industrial facilities in Siberia still have room for further improvement. £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Everything serves the Great Trial.

strings.OMS_darkness_in_the_world_tt: In the end, no one will ever know where our factories are.
strings.OMS_atomic_hearts_tt: The power of the atom can destroy everything...
strings.OMS_death_hand_system_effect_tt: The Dead Hand system will ensure that the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will never fail.

strings.OMS_more_flavor.101.desc:
The biting wind scraped across the vast plains west of the Urals like a razor, whipping up frozen debris that lashed Kirill's already numb face. He drove the last rivet into the cold steel beam, the dull thud almost insignificant in the howling wind. The old soldier's hands were long past frozen, his thick work gloves seemingly fused to his skin.

His old comrade, Arkady, was leaning nearby, lighting a cheap, League-issued cigarette. The ember flickered in the grey gloom, like a dying heartbeat. Beneath their feet, a subterranean fortress, magnificent to the point of absurdity, was taking shape—a concrete behemoth crouching beneath the earth, its steel ribs piercing the surface, pointing toward the sullen firmament.

“Ten years, Kirill. Ten whole years.” Arkady's hoarse voice was shredded by the wind. “From the day we charged out of Tyumen with the commissar, to standing in this godforsaken place. Ten years. Feels like a hundred.”

Kirill didn't speak, just took the cigarette Arkady offered and drew deeply. The acrid smoke made him cough violently, but it also brought a long-lost searing heat to his frozen lungs. He thought of the past ten years. He remembered how he’d smashed open the heads of those monarchist fools shouting “freedom” in the muddy trenches of Vyatka. He remembered dodging the bullets of the Red Army fanatics singing the Internationale in the ruins of Arkhangelsk. He remembered the twisted screams of the madmen who called themselves the “Holy Empire” in the fetid swamps of Komi as the flamethrower's fire consumed them.

They had won. Yes, they had won. Maps were painted black, and a cold voice on the radio declared the reunification of the Motherland. But Kirill looked around and saw only more trenches and more concrete. Russia had become a massive, unmarked grave, and they were its gravediggers.

“Do you think… we'll have another decade, old friend?” Arkady’s voice held a weariness he had only ever heard in death-row inmates. “The Great Trial… they always talk about it. But even if we win, what will be left? A scorched earth? And a bunch of living dead like us, who know nothing but hatred?”
Kirill's gaze traveled past the unfinished fortifications to the endless horizon. He remembered a small wooden house under the Tomsk sun, where his wife Natasha would hang out the sheets to dry, and his daughter Anya would chase butterflies across a meadow filled with cornflowers. That was in another century, another universe. The tide of the Black League had devoured it all, along with his memories, leaving only a cold, black void.
He no longer fought for them. He fought because it was the only thing left to do. Vengeance, a word like a rusty nail, had long been hammered into the coffin of his soul. It couldn't be pulled out, and there was nowhere else for it to go.
“I don't know,” Kirill finally spoke, his voice sounding distant in the wind. “I only know the boss said this wall has to be finished by sunset.”
He dropped the cigarette butt and ground it out with the heel of his worn army boot. The faint spark of light, like an ill-timed jest, was instantly devoured by the boundless cold. From a distance came the guttural shouts of a foreman, urging them back to their posts. Kirill
bent down and picked up the heavy shovel. The cold touch of the iron, penetrating his gloves and piercing to the bone, brought him a strange, almost comforting familiarity.
Because in this vast, iron tomb, this was the only thing that was real.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.101.a: Pick up the shovel and keep digging.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.102.desc:
The punch press fell for the last time with a dull thud, like a weary sigh, and then fell silent forever. Its steel soul dissipated completely as Viktor severed the last main power cable with a crowbar. The shower of sparks cast a fleeting, bright light on his face, grimy and covered in frostbite, before vanishing.

Viktor couldn't remember how long he'd been working in this factory on the outskirts of Novosibirsk. He only knew it was once the 'Novaya Zvezda' Tractor Plant, the industrial heart promised to Siberia in the Bukharin era. Back when he was a person with a name, not just a number, he had personally oiled its conveyor belts. Later, the white-blue-and-red flag of the Republic replaced the hammer and sickle, and he continued to assemble parts here, for a 'democratic future' he never truly understood.

Now, the banner of the Black League hung from a rusty gantry crane, like a vulture eyeing carrion. And his job was no longer assembly, but disassembly.

Every steel beam, every lathe, every usable sheet of iron had to be labeled, registered, and then loaded onto trains bound for the west. They would be reborn in another factory in another city, transformed into gun barrels, artillery shells, or reinforcing bars for bunkers. As for the rest, the parts deemed 'inefficient,' 'decadent,' and 'not worth transporting' by the League—like the crumbling skeleton of the factory at his feet—would be melted down on the spot and cast into rails to bear this train of vengeance on its journey to the Great Trial.

Viktor coughed again, his lungs feeling as if they were being scraped by countless tiny shards of glass. The air here was perpetually filled with the scorched smell of cut metal and unnamable chemical dust. He thought of his wife, Irina. She had died last winter from the same cough. The foreman had merely crossed her name off the register and given her ration of black bread to Viktor, as a 'reward' for 'doubling his efforts to compensate for the loss of labor.'

“Worker 874!”

A commissar in a crisp black uniform, so young it made him sick, was pointing at him with a baton. “Your quota is behind. Do you want to fill the concrete of the Ural Line with your bones?”

Viktor didn't answer, just silently turned and used all his strength to drag a massive steel plate. The plate had once been the base of the punch press, so heavy it seemed to carry all the sorrows of this land. His muscles screamed, and his vision blackened from lack of oxygen. He didn't care about the commissar's threats, nor about the so-called 'Great Trial.' He just wanted to live, even if only for one more day, to see the cold, pale sunrise of Siberia one more time.

Perhaps it was overwork that made him hallucinate. Or perhaps the iron chain, which had been subjected to too many lifts, had finally tired of this endless cycle.

First came a sharp, metallic groan of fatigue.

Then, the commissar's terrified, off-key shout.

Viktor didn't even have time to look up. He only felt an irresistible force descending from above, as if the entire Siberian sky had collapsed. There was no pain, only a moment of stunned surprise, and a single, crystal-clear, absurd thought: Irina, I'm coming to find you.

When his coworkers gathered around, they saw only a pool of dark red, indistinguishable from rust, slowly spreading from beneath the steel plate. The young commissar spat in disgust and turned to the nearest foreman.

“Get him out. Don't delay the progress,” he ordered coldly. “And notify logistics. Worker 874's ration for tonight... is cancelled.”

The foreman nodded numbly and waved over a few equally numb workers. Amidst the ceaseless noise of the factory's deconstruction, no one mentioned Viktor's name again. He was like a piece of scrap metal judged to have 'no recycling value,' silently crushed into the dust of history by this giant machine named 'Vengeance.'
strings.OMS_more_flavor.102.a: Clear away this pile of scrap.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.103.desc:
You swing the pickaxe.

Each time, the collision of cold steel and permafrost becomes an electric shock, shooting from your frostbitten, twig-like fingers up your numb arms, straight to your hollow chest. Your lungs burn in the thin, sharp air, and every exhaled breath instantly condenses into a white mist before being torn apart by the relentless Siberian wind.

You have even forgotten what crime you committed.

Really, you've tried to remember. During those sleepless, long nights filled with the coughs and nightmare-mutterings of dozens of men, you tried to scavenge the dregs of your memory. Was it an ill-timed joke? A drunken complaint? Or a forbidden book with a faded cover you found in a dusty attic? You don't know. Memory is like a repeatedly used iron plate, long since polished smooth as a mirror by daily toil and endless hunger, no longer reflecting any image of the past.

Your name was Vladimir. At least, you vaguely remember someone once calling you that. But here, in the mouth of the foreman who always stands at the edge of the mine pit, his silhouette like a tombstone against the grey sky, you are Number 1138. Your identity is the small, rust-colored piece of ore that bursts from the frozen earth with every fall of your pickaxe.

“You are not prisoners!”

The loudspeaker above the pit suddenly erupts with a harsh, metallic roar—the commissar's pre-recorded daily address. The voice, filled with a twisted, unquestionable fanaticism, echoes over the heads of you silent, living dead.

“You are the Motherland's most precious ore! The Germans have their roaring blast furnaces; we have your burning lungs! They have automated drills; we have your shattered hands! Forget your past identities, you are now the living resources of Russia's vengeance! Every piece of ore you break is a brick for the German fortress! Every drop of sweat you shed will become the fuel for our tanks! Your suffering is the nourishment for the war machine! Die for the Great Trial, and your sacrifice will be remembered!”

A man beside you falls, silently, like a sack of grain emptied of its contents. No one stops, no one even glances at him. The foreman merely makes a mark on his clipboard and impatiently nudges the body with the tip of his boot, as if pushing aside an inconvenient stone. He doesn't even bother to have the body dragged away.

The pickaxe grows heavier. Your vision blurs, and the world before you becomes a monotonous, sickening grey and white. In a pause between the mechanical labor, a thought enters your mind like a ghost—you remember the taste of bread. Not the sawdust-filled black bread they issue here, but something... warm, soft, with the aroma of wheat. Who made it for you? Was it mother? Or a wife? You can't remember.

The false warmth makes you dizzy, but you grit your teeth and violently drive out that damnable, weakness-bringing thought. Weakness means falling, and falling means becoming another stone to be nudged by the foreman's boot. You cannot fall.

After an unknowable amount of time, the whistle signaling the end of labor finally sounds like an amnesty. You drag your heavy feet, along with a crowd of equally silent, equally grey shadows, to queue for a spoonful of gruel with barely visible grains and a piece of tooth-chipping black bread. You wolf it down, tasting nothing.

Returning to the hard wooden plank that can barely be called a 'bed,' you curl up, wrapping yourself in a blanket as thin as paper. You are cold, hungry, tired, but you are still alive.

Sometimes you wonder, when this so-called 'Great Trial' really ends... when the last German has turned to ash... will anyone remember that a man named Vladimir once existed? Or will the entire meaning of your life, all your suffering, ultimately condense into an inconspicuous bullet fired at some nameless enemy, then be completely lost in the clamor of history, unremembered?

There is no answer to this question.

You close your eyes and drift into a deep sleep amidst endless exhaustion. Another day has passed. Tomorrow, you will continue to swing the pickaxe.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.104.desc:
TO: Armaments and Technology Department, Central Command
FROM: Major Antonov, 7th Engineering Reconnaissance Brigade, Ural Military District
SUBJECT: Preliminary Report on the Discovery of 'Facility 734' in the Magnitogorsk Area and its Recovery Value

In accordance with the Supreme Command's directive to survey the Magnitogorsk vicinity for new fortification sites, the 3rd Reconnaissance Platoon of my unit, at 0800 hours today, discovered an unrecorded, completely sealed underground facility at coordinates {redacted}. The entrance was sealed by three meters of reinforced concrete, which was breached by demolition.
Initial assessment indicates the facility's designation is 'Central Materials Science Research Institute 734,' believed to have been emergency-sealed during the German invasion to prevent it from falling into enemy hands. The internal air is stale, but due to its excellent seal and low humidity, most equipment and documents have been spared from complete decay over the decades of silence. Remnants of decayed Bolshevik propaganda on the walls have been documented and deemed worthless historical garbage.
After a preliminary inventory by our accompanying technical operatives, the following high-value assets have been confirmed:

Several 'V-2' type stationary diesel generators in fair condition. This model is a variant of the T-34 tank engine; its parts are compatible or can be modified for use with some of our army's existing armored units, effectively supplementing power deficits at frontline positions.

A largely intact 'Kripto' type electric furnace, with a maximum operating temperature of 1500°C, highly valuable for the smelting and testing of small-batch special alloys. Additionally, a large volume of notes and experimental data on the casting process of molybdenum-chromium alloy steel was found in the archives, offering direct reference for improving the durability of our army's gun barrels and armor plates.

A substantial quantity of sealed chemical reagents, preliminarily identified to include precursors for stabilizers used in synthesizing new solid rocket propellants. Furthermore, several rolls of blueprints for an early experimental model of a 152mm cannon-howitzer were discovered, designed to simplify production and increase range, which can be immediately sent to the Ordnance Department for feasibility assessment. Unpublished research papers on improving the stability of fuel used in early 'Katyusha' rockets were also found.

Hundreds of detailed technical personnel training manuals, equipment operating procedures, and safety regulations. Although outdated, the systematic scientific methodology in these documents remains beneficial for my unit's establishment of a standardized training system for technical branches.

The industrial and technical potential contained within this facility will undoubtedly provide a valuable supplement to the arsenal for the Great Trial. Its value lies not in its dilapidated physical state, but in its potential to be converted into a force to destroy the enemy. My unit recommends:
One. Immediately dispatch an engineering corps and transport units for the systematic dismantling and transfer of all usable machinery.
Two. Appoint scientific cadres and archive experts to thoroughly evaluate, screen, and modernize all documents and research notes.
Three. After recovering all usable materials, the remaining useless structures and contaminated waste are to be demolished on-site and permanently sealed.

Awaiting your command. For the Great Trial.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.104.a: Tear it down. Not a single screw is to be left behind.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.105.desc:
“Worker Viktor, what are you doing! Why did you break the lathe tool? Don't you know that these tools are the League's most precious assets? Not only have you damaged the tools, you have delayed precious production efficiency!”

“And you, Kryuchkov! When the operatives inspected the dormitories today, they found scraps of cut steel under your bed? Do you think your theft of state assets would go undiscovered by us?”

The workers of the entire crew bowed their heads, silent, watching the new head of industrial supervision, operative Andrei, roar at them with a ferocious face, only hoping he would cool down soon and let them return to work.

Their factory, located in Tyumen, was a newly built machine tool plant. When it was completed, several high-ranking League officials came to cut the ribbon, instructing them to work hard and defend the motherland. Although the League's orders were strict, back then, the factory had many experienced old hands. To increase production, the industrial operatives in charge organized several technical training sessions, teaching everyone how to use the equipment and avoid safety hazards. Even the factory's safety supervisor, Konstantin, was a good man. Although his standards were high, he often turned a blind eye to the workers' personal needs, as long as they completed their tasks on time.

But two months ago, Operative Konstantin was transferred, and a young operative named Andrei arrived. Everything changed. Viktor remembered that day when a dozen men in black coats came. After only half a day of inspection, they dragged several workers from other teams out in front of everyone, gave them a severe beating, and warned them of their slothful, revisionist errors. From then on, the atmosphere in the factory changed. The few smiles the workers had completely vanished. Some of the older, more stringent workers were repeatedly reported on. The factory's loudspeakers increasingly broadcast the General Secretary's theories on the Great Trial. Reports submitted by the factory to request new equipment were rejected unless they could achieve rapid efficiency gains. Last month, during the efficiency evaluation, the factory's efficiency had increased by thirty percent, but in their small group alone, there were three industrial accidents. That day, when the industrial operatives presented an award to Viktor's team in front of the whole factory, he still remembered the look the once-friendly coworkers gave him—a look of hatred.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.105.a: Efficiency is paramount, but the human heart is not what it once was.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.106.desc:
A loud bang echoed from Kazakhstan. Project 416 was a success. Commander-in-Chief Yazov was sitting at his desk, reading the report.

“...So you're saying that while we have the technology for the atomic bomb, you believe we haven't fully exploited its potential, is that correct?” After reading the report, Yazov fixed his piercing gaze on the man before him—Vladimir Chelomei. Yazov had seen countless self-recommenders, but among them, some were for money, some for survival, and some for both.

However, he saw none of this in Chelomei. No matter how Yazov tested him, Chelomei remained focused on the pursuit of high technology; he was single-mindedly devoted to his research. “That's right, Comrade Yazov. Our current atomic energy technology serves only the atomic bomb, which is too narrow. Considering the electricity shortage, we need to extend atomic technology to other fields. Not only that, we have some... confidential foreign technologies in our hands, don't we?”

Upon hearing “confidential foreign technologies,” Yazov seemed to sense something. He glanced at Chelomei, saying nothing. Since the start of Operation Potemkin, they had acquired some secret foreign data. This data could indeed be used to develop the Black League's atomic energy and long-range delivery technologies. But how did he know? And why was he reporting this to me? Why did I know nothing of this? He looked up and studied Chelomei carefully. A previous report had mentioned he was a 'Supra-Socialist,' everything for the sake of scientific progress. And he had provided important insights in many fields. Perhaps he truly was just for the advancement of science? Regardless, he signed his name on the document: “Commander-in-Chief, Dmitry Yazov,” and asked Chelomei a simple question:

“What do you want?”
strings.OMS_more_flavor.106.a: “The progress and development of science, Comrade Commander-in-Chief.”
strings.OMS_more_flavor.107.desc:
“Everyone, listen up! All Kazakh 'civilization' is nothing but a lie fabricated by those who seek to fracture our great, unified League! Anyone found hiding any contraband related to this... League law enforcement officers have the right to shoot on sight!” A patrol van with a loudspeaker repeated the various precautions and codes of conduct for League citizens, and beside the vehicle were League soldiers with loaded guns.

Every time they heard this, the residents would instinctively lock their doors and windows. They didn't understand why, even when children as young as a few years old had learned to say 'the Great Trial,' this message was still broadcast on a loop. But today, they found out why.

The van suddenly stopped broadcasting, replaced by a man's voice: “I always believed that some of you would step forward and admit your mistakes, but your performance has been deeply disappointing. Since no one will confess, then you shall all properly face the wrath of the Commander-in-Chief!”

With a single order, those most ferocious of beasts easily smashed down doors and windows, dragging them out of their houses. Shouts, beatings, and wails mixed into one. This was followed by a flurry of frantic searching and reporting. Soon, a map of Kazakhstan, not of the Black League, was pulled from a house.

“Everyone, do you see now? It's not that I'm framing you, but that some among you still fail to understand us, and seek to destroy our united and great League. Since you don't believe in all this, then I will let you see it with your own eyes.”
strings.OMS_more_flavor.107.a: After a command, the sound of a bullet being fired destroyed the voice within their hearts.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.108.t: We Shall Be the Motherland's Eyes
strings.OMS_more_flavor.108.desc:
To: Commander-in-Chief Yazov

From: Yevgeny Savintsev

Commander-in-Chief:

It appears that the existing security bureaus within the League's territory are incompetent to integrate the intelligence and security network in the western part of the Motherland. Therefore, I formally submit an application to you for the establishment of a new intelligence agency for the upcoming Great Trial—the League European Security Bureau, with the following responsibilities:
1. Resolutely uphold the leadership of the Black League and obey the orders of Commander-in-Chief Yazov.
2. In accordance with work needs, legally use necessary methods, means, and channels to carry out intelligence work in Western Europe, the Triumvirate, and the western Motherland.
3. This security bureau will have priority access to resources and personnel, to collect valuable intelligence for the League to the greatest extent possible, including but not limited to railway hubs, military-industrial enterprises, personnel lists, etc.
4. Given that this bureau is the most recently established and faces the largest tasks, it may directly request assistance and support from all internal security bureaus of the Motherland after its establishment.
5. As required by work, the personnel of this bureau may request simplified border inspection procedures.
6. After review and as required by work, operatives may use various technical surveillance and identity protection measures.
7. Upon confirmation by the League and the Commander-in-Chief, it will establish cooperative relationships with individuals and organizations in other countries to further carry out related work.
... (redacted)

The Great Trial is supreme.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.108.a: At At the very bottom of this application form, Yazov's name was prominently displayed.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.109.desc:
Lyudmila Pavlichenko had been numb ever since the uprising.

She had successfully evaded the purges that followed the fall of the Ukrainian Soviet government, surviving by sheer luck until now. Yet, she was but an empty shell. In the post-war years, she was just another nameless farmer in her hometown. No one knew of her past identity, and she was unwilling to speak of her former deeds, wishing only to preserve her life until death came for her. To her, the glories, a.chievements, and splendors of the past had long since faded. She was no 'Hero of the Soviet Union,' but an ordinary farmer. What use was glory to her now? She had once thrown herself into the revolution with a passionate heart, but no matter how hard she tried, defeat was inevitable. But she was indifferent to it all now; she no longer held any hope for the restoration of the Motherland.

It was another unremarkable day. Lyudmila Pavlichenko labored as usual, then returned home. But this time, there was a knock on the door late at night.

“Who is it?” Lyudmila asked warily. “We're from the government.” Lyudmila went to the cellar, fetched her Mosin-Nagant rifle, opened the door, and pointed the gun at the mysterious visitor. “Who are you really! I've never seen any German dare to come to the countryside alone for an inspection!” The mysterious man made no attempt to conceal his identity. “Alright, I'm from the Black League. Have you considered cooperating with us, to carry out some activities behind enemy lines?” The man handed her a card, on which was written in bold:

'Nikolai Kuznetsov, Black League.'

Lyudmila looked at it, gestured for him to sit, shut the door and windows tightly, turned the radio up to its maximum volume, and then scrutinized the man. In her memory, the land east of the A-A Line was still a wasteland, difficult to unify. Yet, the man before her now came from east of the A-A Line.

“So, what do you want?” “It's simple. You just need to carry out some behind-the-lines activities. If you agree, you will be given the codename 'Diamond,' and play an important role in the coming war...”

Lyudmila's thoughts drifted back to the past. Then, she was a Hero of the Soviet Union, a legendary sniper. Now, she was nothing. Her conscience urged her to act, but the old fears still lingered in her mind: what if she failed? Where would she go then? She had no way of knowing. But in the end, the long-dead Hero of the Soviet Union, the Nazi-slayer, Lyudmila Pavlichenko, once again donned her mantle.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.109.a: The former hero of the Soviet Union will still fight for her Motherland.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.110.desc:
To: All Departments of the Russian National Rejuvenation Government
From: Commander-in-Chief Yazov

All Departments:
Following the unification of the Motherland, the coordination mechanisms between regions are suffering from severe operational defects. Small-scale armed rebellions continue to erupt in multiple locations, having a detrimental effect on the implementation of the next phase of the Great Trial. All departments are hereby ordered to conduct coordination work according to the following instructions, and complete the corresponding tasks within the prescribed time limits. Dereliction of duty will be prosecuted as treason under military law, in accordance with General Order GL-003.
I. Accelerate the process of regional economic integration. The Ministry of National Development is ordered to ensure local industrial facilities resume production. More military facilities are to be constructed in important cities and at transportation nodes. Furthermore, in accordance with General Order GL-0034, construction of anti-nuclear underground facilities is to be carried out in designated cities (see encrypted appendix 1). This work will be under the full command of Minister Yevgeny Pitovranov.
II. Eliminate armed rebels across all regions. All military districts are ordered to strictly complete the eradication of armed rebels within their jurisdictions by the deadlines (see encrypted appendix 2). If necessary, and with the approval of the General Staff, cross-regional operational command headquarters may be established. In addition, border military districts must simultaneously make preparations to ensure their capability to execute various special missions from the General Staff. This work will be under the full command of Minister Yuri Drozdov.
III. Enhance the rigor of political vetting. The Ministry of State Administration is ordered to immediately raise the political vetting level for former non-Black League officers and political figures, implementing round-the-clock surveillance to ensure absolute loyalty. Those confirmed through investigation to have subversive intent or actions will be secretly tried by the special tribunal previously established in secret by the Ministry of State Administration, to minimize negative impact. This work will be under the full command of Minister Yevgeny Savintsev.
…
The Great Trial will come.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.111.desc:
...
  In summary, over the past few months, through discussions among the Commander-in-Chief, relevant government departments, and various Russian scholars, a consensus has been reached: Russia's failure in the First Trial, and the subsequent fragmentation of our homeland, stemmed from the ideological and psychological subversion of Russian citizens by foreign powers, and the influence of decadent ideologies such as Nazism, capitalism, anarchism, and Bolshevism. These destructive ideas corrupted Russia's original traditional thoughts and values, causing ideological chaos among the Russian people, which led to their inability to unite against the invading Western Nazi enemy, resulting in national fragmentation and a series of other consequences.
  Simultaneously, in response to the numerous revisionist thoughts and corrupt behaviors that have emerged during our work, and to preserve the precious spirit of struggle cultivated by the Commander-in-Chief and the excellent operatives of the Black League during the Great Trial, as well as to protect Russia's original traditional values, the Rejuvenation Government hereby proposes that we must carry out a historic reform. From this day forward, the Russian people must adhere to the spirit and values of Russian Rejuvenationism, proposed by Commander-in-Chief Yazov and revised and perfected by the various commissars of the League. The specific contents are as follows:
...
At all times and in all places, Russians shall abide by the national rejuvenation values, from the state to the family. The specific contents include:
At the state level, Russian citizens shall cultivate patriotism and civic consciousness. Every Russian must be clear that he is first and foremost a citizen of the Russian state, and he has the obligation to serve the Motherland and be responsible for its fate. Russia's sovereignty shall not be infringed upon by anyone. Every Russian citizen has the responsibility to serve the Motherland and its destiny.
...
At the social level, Russian citizens shall establish a collectivist mindset. Every citizen should learn to help one another in daily life and work; the spiritual is superior to the material. Russian citizens should possess civic consciousness, understanding that the family is a strong bond. Every member of the family should establish lofty moral ideals. When the organization and collective are in need, every Russian citizen should serve the cause of Russian rejuvenation with selfless labor.
...
At the personal level, Russian citizens must learn to remember and pass on history, to firmly remember the various crimes committed against the Russian nation by the Western Germanic beasts throughout history. Vengeance against the Germans is a right and duty that every Russian citizen must possess. If faced with an enemy invasion, every Russian citizen should unleash slaughter upon the invaders with great hatred. For all revisionists and degenerate elements, sympathy and mercy must be abandoned.
...
Organizations at all levels should exert an irreplaceable organizational and motivational force in the current cause of national rejuvenation, ensuring that the current difficulties in the process of national rejuvenation are overcome, until the work is completed... achieving the cause of national rejuvenation with the invincible spirit and values of national rejuvenation.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.112.desc:
“Bring them over, these sons of bitches must all be executed today!”
“Let go of me, you black-clothed beasts, to drop chemical weapons on the heads of your own countrymen, do you have any humanity left?”
Mikhail was kicked to the ground. His leg was broken, forcing him to his knees, yet he still tried to glare at these black-clad soldiers with fury. He had once followed Valery Sablin, trying to start a revolution in the Far East to save Russia. But Sablin failed, and he and his comrades were forced into exile. He had always tried to organize guerrilla units, waiting for his Western comrades to return and revive the Soviets. But what came was not the Red Army, but the soldiers of the Black League.
After a gunshot, a comrade fell into the shallow pit dug by these black-clad dogs. A young comrade in the line burst into tears, only to be viciously struck down by the leader, Operative 236650, and then gagged. Mikhail turned his head. He saw a group of people also being escorted at gunpoint, walking towards them. Judging by their clothes, some were well-dressed, looking like so-called democrats, while a few were blindfolded, still wearing Nazi armbands.
“Operative 236650, I have brought all the people you wanted. They are now at your disposal.”
“Very good, soldier, you've done well. I will report your merits to my superior.” The operative smiled, then waved to the firing squad behind him: “Time to get to work, shoot all this garbage!”
A few people began to struggle, trying to escape, only to be met first with the bullets of the Black League soldiers. The rest remained silent, awaiting their impending fate. Mikhail watched the entire process, yet suddenly felt a sense of relief in his heart. Comrade Sablin had done his duty, fighting for the revolution until the very end. He had tried. Now, he too was about to die, and his responsibility was also coming to an end.
Operative 236650 quietly walked up to him: “You seem quite brave, not like a coward. The Black League is in short supply of people right now, we need strong warriors like you, who have a deep-seated hatred for the Nazis. Join us, and I’ll let you live. What do you say?”
Mikhail closed his eyes and uttered his last words.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.112.a: “I am a soldier of the revolution, not a soldier for butchers!”
strings.OMS_more_flavor.113.desc:
At six in the evening, most of the citizens of Chernyshevsk finished their day's work and were out looking for a place to rest. Although they now had a new master over them, some Commander Yazov, work had increased, and a curfew had been imposed at night. But at least the country was now unified, and crime in the city had noticeably decreased, so people were content to accept it.

But as they walked, they noticed something was wrong: a large screen had been set up in the city's central square, surrounded by heavily armed soldiers. A few men in black were busy below, and many citizens stopped to watch them, soon filling the square.

“Hey, sirs, what are you doing here?” a brave citizen shouted out.

“Orders from above, we're showing a movie for the next few days! To let you know what happened to the country in the past!” an operative below responded with a megaphone. “We will now begin the movie ‘Traitors Have No Tomorrow!’”

Soon, images appeared on the screen, and the area around the square teemed with people, all crowding to see what was being shown. The first thing on the screen was four large words: The First Trial. A few Russians stood beside a group of Germans, pointing and gesturing in a language they couldn't understand; a group of tanks charged from a distance, scattering the Russian lines; a map on the screen showed the Russian army on the verge of reaching Moscow, only to be mercilessly pushed back.

Many of the Russian citizens in the audience closed their eyes, unwilling to relive the past pain, but the movie did not stop. The next theme was: The Land of Suffering. A succession of characters and subtitles flashed by: a group of men speaking a garbled German, dressed in tattered German uniforms, abusing young people; a so-called Tsar shouting about returning Russian land to the landlords; a group called the Russian Liberation Army, on one hand contacting those traitorous collaborators, on the other hand claiming to bring democracy to Russia; a certain fellow named Dragunov, with a house full of money, talking about how Russia should be divided. Many in the audience were seething with anger, clenching their fists.

Soon, the scene shifted to the next theme: “National Rejuvenation.” First, an old man foretold the future of the great national trial to the Russian people in a steady voice, and then it was Commander Yazov. Many were seeing him for the first time. Under his command, the brave warriors of the League defeated those national traitors, and shot them all. He personally mourned the soldiers who died in battle. Many people became engrossed in the film without realizing it. At the end, when they watched the armored soldiers of the Black League charge eastward, and the diligent operatives capture and execute the German spies hidden in their ranks, many in the crowd cheered sincerely.

Soon, the movie ended. The audience was still reluctant to leave. Suddenly, a voice from the crowd shouted out: “Down with the German demons, long live Russia!”

The crowd was stunned for a moment, but soon, men and women, old and young, also began to shout, a thunderous roar sweeping across the entire square.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.113.a: “Down with the German demons, long live Russia!”
strings.OMS_more_flavor.114.desc:
Although sleep had been his only solace since being forcibly conscripted for biochemical experiments, Anatoly had been having nightmares for several days in a row. In his dreams, either the vengeful ghosts of the men used as test subjects in his lab came for him, or the children who were shot on sight for having 1/8th German blood tore at his flesh in hell. Fortunately, a shout following a violent slam of the door pulled him from his dream: “Anatoly Vladimirovich! A new batch of test subjects has arrived!”

The short man shivered reflexively, then stood up from the sweat-soaked chair: “Sir, the data from the last experiment has not been fully collected, this may be against regulations…” The lieutenant impatiently explained: “This is an urgent order from above, there’s no time for so many regulations now.” Then, he changed his tone: “You should be clear about the consequences of not finishing, right?” Anatoly dared not disobey, and immediately put on a sycophantic smile: “Understood, sir, I guarantee the mission will be completed.”

After the demon in black boots left, he could only continue to sit at the experimental table, observing those small, deadly things. When the living cells used for the experiment lysed, a fragment of memory flashed through his mind: it was an old man, escorted to the execution ground for some unknown reason, his head shattered by a shotgun, bone fragments splattering all over the ground.

…

Pushing aside another nauseating memory he didn't want to recall, Anatoly wrote the experiment report, forcing down his discomfort. This time, the virus development seemed very successful. Its infectivity far exceeded his expectations, and its latency was also quite good. However, the fear and nausea he had suppressed soon grew rampant when he noticed a piece of detached, already rotten flesh in the corner of the isolation room. The image of the woman, her body covered in pustules, resurfaced in his mind. With a “Waah—,” he finally couldn't hold it in and vomited.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.114.a: That night, he had another nightmare.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.115.desc:
“This is Squad 109, we have reached the target factory. Yes, our next objective is to dismantle two production machine tools in the target factory. The urban operatives inside the factory will cooperate with our work.” A masked League officer gave the order to the action team behind him without emotion. No one could see the expression beneath his mask.
“Resistance will be treated as treason,” the soldiers replied without emotion.
The squad marched into the factory. The workers, who were busy at their tasks, stopped their work to look at the group of ferocious-looking soldiers. The factory owner and two urban operatives quickly walked out of the office, saluted, and took the official document from the captain. After just one glance, his brows furrowed.
“Sir, these two machine tools are the most efficient in our factory. If we dismantle them, our factory's efficiency will inevitably drop too much, and the bedding we provide for the city will be…”
“Resistance will be treated as treason,” the captain replied coldly.
The factory owner glanced at the captain, reluctantly lowered his head, signed the dismantling list, and let the two operatives lead the squad to the dismantling site. The workers in the factory followed the squad to the two machine tools. “Now, dismantle this thing and move it to the truck outside,” the captain declared.
“No, you can't!” an old worker shouted, rushing to the machine tool. “Brothers, this thing is our factory's heirloom, the whole city's bedding is produced from this thing, if you dismantle this thing, everyone's children will…”
“Bang.”
