As we expected, it's the result of the NBC production facilities that were recently established near the northern border of the Co-Prosperity Sphere. Due to the rushed nature of the program, the test of the AN416 nuclear device was a failure that caused tremendous unintended damage to their own population.

Signal intercepts from Germany and America indicate that both our adversaries believe that this self-inflicted nuclear disaster will set back the Russian program by several years. However, we have seen an increase in the activity in the facilities throughout Siberia in recent days. While the hermit state remains difficult for our agents to penetrate it's clear that our adversaries are misguided in their beliefs.

We must not alert the Russians to the fact that we've seen through their deception as this may further complicate our efforts to gather information within Russia.

Recommend to Tokyo that they take measures to safeguard against this threat including increased military readiness along the Siberian border.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.18.desc:
Comrade Glavkoverkh Yazov,
I'm pleased to report that organized Finnish resistance has been quelled. The task proved easier than expected as Finland's decades of grueling counter-insurgency war has left the country hollowed out and demoralized. While the reserve army stationed in Finland suffered some casualties, they were significantly lighter than initially estimated. We estimate that over 90% of the men that served in the army have either been killed, arrested or deported.

It will be several years before we can achieve full Russification of the region and fully phase out the barbaric culture and language of the Finns and their Swedish siblings. To expediate the process, a substantial amount of the native population has been transferred to southern Kazakhstan with loyal Russians being moved in to replace them.

A fitting end to the Finnish problem. After spending years trying to colonize and erode everything Russian in Karelia, they've instead been broken as a people after having the same methods used against them and applied with overwhelming force.

As operations are winding down, I've approved for the immediate transfer of excess manpower from the reserve army to be redeployed into our main forces along the border with Moskowien for the honorable duty of serving in the Great Trial.

Signed,
Yuri Drozdov
strings.OMS_more_flavor.19.desc:
To: OKB-Karbyshev Department of Ordnance Requisition /nFrom: Krasnoyarsk-7 Testing Department #4

After further evaluation we've come to the conclusion that the general's request to investigate the possibility to outfit our main battle tanks with a modified version of the chemical thrower cannot be fulfilled.

On the move, the toxic gasses from the chemical canisters are too unstable and pose a health risk to our tankers under combat conditions. In all tests that were conducted, at least one and sometimes all crew members ended up being hospitalized due to the conditions. In one of these instances, the vision restrictions imposed on the crews by the protective gear was the main culprit as the tank ended up colliding with a wall.

Thanks to our safety precautions all test volunteers will be able to return to regular combat duty in the near future. However as not a single stress test saw the tank come within firing range of the designated mock target, all testing on the CT-60 chemical tank are to be halted until further notice.

In more positive news, the conventional flamethrower tank tests proved to be an outstanding success. In the final trials the entire tank squadron managed to reach the Teutonic mock village our engineers had built and successfully burnt it to the ground fast enough to ensure minimal theoretical survivors even under intense combat conditions. We recommend that the OT-60M is fast-tracked for production this instant.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.19.a: A precursor to the hell we'll send our enemies to.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.20.desc:
The telegram had been laying on the old man's desk for several minutes, silently observed by a bespectacled pair of eyes that couldn't hide the shock and disgust he felt over what was just read. Countless messages had passed through this tidy section of the Foreign Office and thousands of those had been parsed by Sven, yet not once could he recall anything as absurd as what he'd just read. It was effectively a demand for Germany's unconditional surrender of everything the great nation had fought so hard to achieve, all without a single shot being fired. If the aged gentleman had possessed a single informal bone in his body, he'd surely have laughed at such a ridiculous notion that could only have been concocted by the fertile imagination of the barbaric Slav.

Just as he was about to pick up the cursed piece of paper to bin it, an air raid siren started to ring from outside. His stomach started to turn, and he started to read it again, his eyes dancing between the words with increasing horror as he realized that what he was reading wasn't a poorly formulated joke by a rogue state but an actual statement of intent that amounted to a declaration of war. He read it again, and then again, and then a third time just to make sure he wasn't in a bad dream. Sweatdrops started to form on his wrinkled, balding head and he nearly made it to a fourth re-reading of the telegram when a loud explosion rocked the entire city block, making the man fall out of his chair as the window to his office shattered from the force of the blast.

For a brief moment, the old veteran of war and politics felt something he hadn't felt since his trenches in Russia had been shelled. Adrenaline alone got him back up on his feet without a care for the shards of glass surrounding him. As he looked out of the blown-out window with his bare eyes, he realized to his horror that the regional office next to his had been struck with a missile, three entire floors being obliterated by the force of the blow with many more explosions thundering across the old Prussian city. To his horror, he realized what this meant.
strings.OMS_more_flavor.20.a: Germany was once again at war, and with an adversary more brutal than any other.
strings.OMS_failstate.1.desc:
“Pitor,”

Piotr slowly glanced over at his comrade, Fyodor, a look of exhaustion strewn about his face.

“What?” Piotr said softly, himself also having felt the effects of days without sleep.

“...Do you think the end for us is near? As in, we no longer have to keep fighting?” Fyodor said, albeit with an unassured tone.

Pitor's eyes shifted from Fyodor's face to that of the wall behind him, as he looked out at the vast expanse of death and decay from the slit in their bunker. Then he looked up, looking through the massive hole blown through their bunker from days before. Of the 10 men sent to defend this position, only the 2 men remained after the bunker buster was dropped on their heads.

“Perhaps... maybe the end is across the field over yonder.”

Suddenly, a loud static chirp was heard from the radio, which the 2 men thought it to be broken. They had not heard a word from high command in the last five days.

“Comrade soldiers, this is your commander speaking. You are to all reposition yourselves just outside the national redoubt. Our struggle does not end here. Vengeance will be ours. Long live comrade Glavkoverkdh {rus_getleader}.”

“Was that Lazarenko?” Fyodor chipped in, this time with a hint of excitement in his voice. Finally, they had gotten confirmation that all was not lost yet. The 2 men collected their items and made their way out of the bunker as they heard the sounds of heavy rocket engines overhead, and a quick blur passes right over their heads.
strings.OMS_failstate.2.desc:
A mild static marred the broadcast as the news broadcast switched from the dry, almost mechanical introductory reading from the German news anchor to the chaotic scenes of what used to be Sverdlovsk, recently conquered as the Black League made its atomic scorched earth retreat to behind the Urals. Despite the evident tumult, the RRG’s finest as always put on a confident show for the cameras.

“... We are reporting live from the recently liberated Katherinenburg. Behind me you can see that there’s a lot of activity at the recently established headquarters for the nuclear, biological and chemical protection forces.” Said the German war correspondent with a straight face, trying his best to give the impression that everything was finally under control after the devastation that had punctuated the fighting in the region. The reporter took a deep breath before he continued to speak.

“There remains no sign of the leader of the Russian horde, {rus_getleader}, who is presumed to have died in the destruction of his mountain fortress. We’ve been assured by the newly appointed Reichskommissar Walther Wenck that the Heer will soon eliminate the last pockets of resistance in Russia and the final victory is well within sight in the war against Russia.”

Another deep breath. The reporter had the briefest expression of anxiety on his face before he spoke again. “The effects of the small-scale deployment of nuclear weaponry by the incompetent and barbaric Russians has, as expected, resulted in only minor damage as the nuclear warheads were largely intercepted before they could strike our heroic soldiers. Not even the most underhanded attempts by the enemy can delay the eastward march of Germany’s heroic sons, let alone stop it, as they honor Germany and the Führer with yet another success!”

“In other news, we will soon have an interview with the head of peacekeeping and anti-banditry in Siberia, Gustav Wagner, declared by the Führer himself to be the best man for the job of capturing the remaining Russian bandits. Please stay tuned for the interview.” With a flick of a button, the tv was turned off.
strings.OMS_failstate.3.desc:
David Halberstam checked his microphone. It had been giving him trouble a few minutes ago, but by some miracle it was working again just as they were going live on air in this God-forsaken land. Out of all wars he’d have to cover, none were giving as much pain in every sense of the word as this one. The fact that the camera lens hadn’t been frozen was a surprise to him as the red light lit up.

What greeted viewers from across the Pacific was a reporter, clad in winter gear, in front of a mostly undamaged village. As the League had fallen apart, cities were taken with gradually less resistance as only the most radical remained devoted to {rus_getleader}'s cause at this point. Long gone were the days of metropolitans like Irkutsk and Kansk needing to be fought over block by block.

“Good morning. I'm David Halberstram with CBS, presenting you with an exclusive look at the liberated territories of Sakha in Siberia.” He said in a matter-of-fact way. “Specifically, we are reporting to you in the village of Vilyuysk, one of the coldest places on earth.” Halberstream's face was neutral for the most part.


“The collapse of the Russian Government has been marked a monumental victory for the joint forces of the United States and her allies, as well as for the world at large. The world came closer than any point in history to nuclear war, thanks to our brave soldiers, this has thankfully been averted.”


Halberstream decided to take a moment before resuming. “Already the scale of the humanitarian crisis in Russia has been realized, supplies are expected to arrive within the next week to help the local population who have been subjected to the hardships of war, even in these remote places. As many as-”

An explosion occurred in a building across the street, Halberstream cursed as both him and the cameraman started to run even as the tape rolled. Moments later, the broadcast cut out due to what was charitably called “technical difficulties”.
strings.OMS_failstate.3.a: For some, the struggle is far from over.
strings.OMS_nuclearfoci.1.desc:
The last bullet is fired in Germania. Endless bodies litter the streets. Men torn apart by bullets, stabbed by bayonets, and choked by thick clouds of toxic gas that had been ruthlessly unleashed upon the once great city. Ripped apart by artillery shells, rockets, and mines. Left to rot in burning tanks and behind abandoned barricades that no longer served any purpose now that the battle was lost.

Buildings that once served as centers of life and commerce have been reduced to nothing but foundations, coated in thick layers of crumbling brick and mortar. Bakeries, corner stores, and the homes of thousands had been burnt to cinders. The once mighty factories that were at the heart of Europe’s industries lay in ruins with the workers that toiled within these buildings now resting within the rubble.

Atop all of it, on the half-burnt husk of the Reichstag, stood a man. A man in a black rubber suit and hood, face concealed by a mask white as the face of Death, and a bright yellow armband wrapped around his arm slowly made his way through the toxic miasma and twisted metal that marked the final great engagement between the League and Germania’s last SS defenders.

He slowly approached one of the flag poles hanging over the side. With the bayonet affixed to his rifle, he carefully cut the tattered flag of the Reich free and watched it flutter into the poisonous wind. One of his comrades opened a backpack and unveiled a flag of black and bright yellow. The standard of the Black League, their symbol of absolute victory.

After a few moments, the flag was waving from the side of the building, held aloft by the soldiers that marched from Siberia to the heart of the Reich. Over the crumbling foundations of a city that had been destroyed in all but name. The men stepped back, looking over the ruins that lay before them. After all of their struggle and pain, it was over.
strings.OMS_nuclearfoci.1.a: Hatred of the invading enemy is the most sacred and humane feeling.
strings.OMS_News.1.desc:
Across territories of the Reich, devastating terrorist attacks on key installments have taken place near simultaneously. In Germania, key government buildings were targeted by small explosives in just a matter of hours. In addition, other targets such as railroad junctions and Heer supply depots were also hit. The attacks are being particularly concentrated within the German Reichskommissariats.

The perpetrators have identified themselves as members of the “Army for Russian Liberation”, who advocate for the return of former Russian lands to the Omsk-based Russian government. In turn, they have long decried Germany's treatment of the occupied Russian lands. Their cause has received consistent support from members
of the Organization of Free Nations, most notably the United States.
strings.OMS_News.1.a: How will the Führer respond to this?
strings.OMS_News.2.desc:
In a move perhaps only unexpected to the Russians, Pakt forces have begun a massive counter-attack across the entire front, aimed at driving back Russian Black League forces from the Moscow frontier, German-held Ukraine, the Baltics, and Finland. Dubbed “Operation Autumn Thunder”, the offensive has seemingly carried massive buildup and has involved, for perhaps the first time, almost complete coordination between Pakt air, ground, and sea assets working in tandem against the Black Leagues' Armies.

Caught completely off guard, it is rumored Russian formations have already begun to break, a rumor firmly denied by Russian High Command who state that whilst the counter-attack was unexpected, it will be “duly repulsed”.
strings.OMS_News.2.a: Chaos takes hold and Russia continues to burn...
strings.OMS_News.3.desc:
As the fury of The Great Trial casts its fiery cloak over all of Eastern Europe, photos and news leaks coming in from Russia show disturbing reports of Russian Glavkoverkh, Dimitry Yazov, disposing of several high ranking officials from both the military and civilian administration. While no official reason has been given as to why, analysts believe that the purges are due to Yazov’s dissatisfaction with the performance of the war in Europe, which has slowly grinded down to an impasse similar in vein to the First World War.

The purges seem to reach all echelons of the military and government, a scale which hasn’t been seen since Hitler’s Night of Long Knives. Officials from Germany state that this outcome was ‘expected from an adversary as savage as the Slav’. Meanwhile, Yazov expressed assurance that he simply is ensuring that his government is free of ‘influence from outside forces’.
strings.OMS_News.3.a: They are all guilty of the unforgivable crime: failure.
strings.OMS_News.3.b: They’re destroying themselves! Now is our time to strike!
strings.OMS_News.4.desc:
Years of fighting and countless millions of casualties on both sides has finally come to a close today with an exhaustive nuclear exchange between the Black League and the combined arsenals of the other superpowers. Although the German Reich has claimed nominal victory following a complete nuclear annihilation of Russia, it remains a pyrrhic triumph.

From the streets of Warsaw to the bunkers buried deep in the Urals, Eastern Europe lies in shambles. The exchange has brought countless cities to ruin and completely halted any sort of ground fighting. With {rus_getleader} missing and presumed dead, many expect the Black League to face complete governmental collapse. Even though the German Reich still stands, it remains a husk of its former self. With hundreds of millions of dead across the world, and many more missing, the future for humanity is bleak.
strings.OMS_News.4.a: For the madness of one, the world paid the price.
strings.OMS_News.5.desc:
The Great Trial has finally come to an end. After countless months of brutal warfare through Russia and countless millions of casualties, the flag of the Black League flies over Russia no more following the collapse of the League’s so-called National Redoubt. German soldiers breached the final line of fortified cities earlier this month and fought block by block, mountain by mountain to assert control over the Urals and what laid beyond them. As the last holdouts were captured, the Black League and its apocalyptic plans have fallen.

Even as {rus_getleader}'s remains were identified in the ruins of Orsk and the Black League faces complete annihilation, the fight hasn't ended. Countless remnants of fanatic devotees of the former government have already established themselves across Russia. Although the Great Trial has come to an end, the war is far from over for Germany.
strings.OMS_News.5.a: nihil vidi post me, et finem ante me vidi.
strings.OMS_News.5.b: Eurasia breathes a sigh of relief.
strings.OMS_News.6.desc:
The Great Trial has finally come to an end. After countless months of brutal warfare through Russia and countless millions of casualties, flag of the Black League flies over Russia no more following the collapse of the League’s so-called National Redoubt. A joint OFN-CPS invasion force breached the final line of fortified cities earlier this month and fought inch-by-inch over the inhospitable Siberian wastes and what laid beyond them. As the last holdouts were captured, the Black League and its apocalyptic plans have fallen.

Even as {rus_getleader}'s remains were identified in the ruins of Orsk and the Black League faces complete annihilation, the fight hasn't ended. Countless remnants of fanatic devotees of the former government have already established themselves across Russia. Although the Great Trial has come to an end, the war is far from over for Germany.
strings.OMS_News.6.a: nihil vidi post me, et finem ante me vidi.
strings.OMS_News.6.b: Eurasia breathes a sigh of relief.
strings.OMS_News.7.t: {get_newspaper_header}The United States and Japan Declare War on the Black League
strings.OMS_News.7.desc:
In a joint statement issued from the OFN and CPS military leadership, it was stated that military units from both Japan and the United States have begun operations against Black League. At dawn, tanks crossed the border between Manchuria and Siberia, marking another escalation in the ongoing war between Russia and Germany.

This comes after warnings issued from both Washington and Tokyo were addressed to the Russian government, calling for an end to the use of chemical and biological weapons throughout Europe. However, in an act of defiance against global pressures, Russia has refused to abide by international law. It seems that, once more, humanity has found itself in a global struggle against itself.
strings.OMS_News.7.a: Perhaps there will be a war to end all wars...
strings.OMS_far_eastern.1.desc:
FROM: {jap_getleader}
ADDRESSED TO: National Reclamation Government of Russia
SUBJECT: Final Warning

Let it be known from this day onward if the situation within Eastern Europe devolves any further into such senseless and mindless butchery, the Empire of Japan and its allies will take preemptive measures to ensure the stability and defense of members within the Greater East Asian Co-Prosperity Sphere. The government of Japan is especially concerned that many of the facilities producing the chemical and biological weapons being used against Germany are located in close proximity to nations allied to the Co-Prosperity Sphere and therefore pose an existential risk to our collective security.



We strongly urge negotiations with the Germans immediately to avoid any further use of banned weapons arising and start abiding by the non-proliferation treaty for atomic, biological and chemical weaponry. This will be our only warning.



Signed,
{jap_getleader}
strings.OMS_far_eastern.1.a: Yet another repugnant ally of the Teuton's impeding the process of true justice.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.4.t: CONFIDENTIAL - A REPORT FROM THE KEMPEITAI
strings.OMS_far_eastern.4.desc:
TO: The Prime-Minister of Japan
FROM: Kempeitai HQ (Kyushu)
SUBJECT: Deployment of Nuclear Weapons in Central Europe
An intelligence tip from agencies based in the United States have revealed a startling conclusion: that Black League agents have planted a number of nuclear weapons in Central Europe, most likely with the intent of initiating a pre-emptive strike on cities and infrastructure. As is proper for the security of the Japanese nation and His Imperial Majesty, the Kempeitai heavily recommends intervention.

As per your latest directive, we have begun a slow regime of intelligence sharing with the Americans, and as such are prepared to begin the drafting of a joint-plan of action in order to prevent the detonation of the bombs. Additionally, we recommend that the Imperial Japanese Army and Navy begin preparations of the highest severity for war as Omsk's deployment of forces grows more aggressive.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.4.a: Approved. Let us hope they succeed…
strings.OMS_far_eastern.5.t: TOP SECRET - FOR THE PRESIDENT'S EYES ONLY - URGENT
strings.OMS_far_eastern.5.desc:
TO: POTUS
FROM: Central Intelligence Agency

SUBJECT: Deployment of Nuclear Weapons in Central Europe

According to the latest observations of the Central Intelligence Agency, we have irrefutable proof that Black League agents have begun the confidential deployments of “Glavkoverkhbombas”, nuclear-weapons placed in strategic locations across Central Europe. The CIA has immense fears that these bombs represent the start of nuclear devastation with Omsk plans to inflict upon Germany, and potentially the world.

As per POTUS directive, we have informed our Sphere partners of this development, and are actively working to intervene in the bombs' deployments in an effort to potentially prevent a “hot war” scenario, the consequences of which can only be described as apocalyptic in nature.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.5.a: Let's hope Tokyo gets this quick…
strings.OMS_far_eastern.6.t: CONFIDENTIAL - A REPORT FROM THE KEMPEITAI
strings.OMS_far_eastern.6.desc:
TO: The Prime-Minister of Japan

FROM: Kempeitai HQ (Kyushu)

SUBJECT: Potential and Realized Deployments of Black League WMDs

Observations from listening posts and satellites have revealed a sharp increase in the buildup of suspected biological weapons laboratories and testing sites in Russia's Far East specifically aligned along the borders of CPS-friendly governments and Manchuria. This coincides with the widespread deployment of WMDs in the Moskowien region against German forces.

It is highly feared that escalation in any form or capacity will inevitably bring the war into Mongolia, Manchuria, and other Sphere-controlled territory. The Kempeitai make the strongest recommendation to increase troop buildup and CBRN training and unit concentrations in and around the border with Russia in accordance with this threat.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.7.t: TOP SECRET – FOR THE PRESIDENT'S EYES ONLY
strings.OMS_far_eastern.7.desc:
TO: POTUS

FROM: Col. Daniel Bard, USEUCOM

SUBJECT: Use of WMDs in Eastern Europe and Civilian Loss

Observations from both satellite and witness testimonials have confirmed our worst fears. The Black League, in an attempt to gain the advantage, have begun the mass deployment and use of tactical nuclear weapons on the front against Germany. In combination with the League's already lacking policy in terms of the preservation of civilian life, all reasonable estimates have put civilian casualties in the millions.

Recommendations from USEUCOM are to stand all forces at high readiness whilst further observations commence. The use of WMDs, in the eyes of command, will inevitably beget a further climbing of the escalation ladder as the Black League continues seeking increasingly destructive means of achieving their objectives.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.8.desc:
The Great Trial has finally come to an end. After countless months of brutal warfare through eastern Russia and countless millions of casualties, flag of the Black League flies over Russia no more following the collapse of the League’s so-called National Redoubt. A joint OFN-CPS invasion force breached the final line of fortified cities earlier this month and fought inch-by-inch over the inhospitable Siberian wastes and what laid beyond them. As the last holdouts were captured, the Black League and its apocalyptic plans have fallen.

Even as Yazov's remains were identified in the ruins of Orsk and the Black League faces complete annihilation, the fight hasn't ended. Countless remnants of fanatic devotees of the former government have already established themselves across Russia. Although the Great Trialhas come to an end, the war is far from over for Germany.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.8.a: And yet, the Pacific breathes a sigh of relief.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.10.desc:
After the first reboot, the officer snatched the phone to receive orders from Tokyo. The command was clear. His district commander instructed an immediate retaliatory strike, under the assumption that with Germany's bombing, a dead man's switch contingency had been invoked. Nuclear war had begun. He put down the phone and looked back. His men sat still as stone. The radar screen was filled to the brim with pips.

After the third reboot, his mind came to accept what his stomach already had. It was an awfully weird phenomenon to feel embarrassment in his final moments, however he had regretfully vomited on the floor. If one of his men had done so, he would've instructed a lashing. With a wry and almost insane smile, he came to realize his command had been one exactly like the one had endured before his promotion: one of cruelty and abuse.

 On the fourth and final reboot, his technicians had managed to track the basic velocity and targeting data of the missiles. The first wave headed for Manchuria; many more flew to other targets across China, Taiwan, and even the Home Islands. He grabbed his activation keys and conjoined them with his second-in-command. Gingerly, they both inserted them into the small locked cabinet that carried the launch codes. His hands shook. To even touch or glance at it previously was to invite death.

 His judgement and heart screamed at him to reconsider. What if his system was still damaged? What if a final reboot would fix the computer, an import from Guangdong, and reveal the pips were simply mirages? If he launched these missiles now, it would be he who ended the world, who could potentially end 2,600 years of Japanese existence. But, he had his orders. His key turned and the small metal door flipped open.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.10.a: Long live the Empire of Japan.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.11.desc:
TO: Glavkoverkh Yazov

FROM: Colonel Igor Rodionov, Far East Command

SUBJECT: CPS Buildup On The Border

Comrade Glavkoverkh,

Reports from our comrades in the Black Hand indicate that Japan, Manchuria, and other members from the Co-Prosperity Sphere are aligning their forces along our shared border in large quantities and have adopted a high alert stance. Additionally, we have detected movement of yet additional reserve troops and accompanying heavy equipment towards it. There is no indication that the buildup of men and matériel is for any aggressor action, but the force concentration is concerning nonetheless.

Therefore, my staff and I recommend preparing a new force to take up defensive positions in central Siberia and the Far East. In spite of the tentatively neutral stance of CPS forces in the area, doing so still gives us time to implement measures dedicated to stopping any potential incursions by Japan and its satellite states should they appear.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.12.t: Diplomatic Cable From the American Embassy
strings.OMS_far_eastern.12.desc:
TO: Glavkoverkh Yazov and the Russian Government

FROM: The White House, Washington D.C.

SUBJECT: Final Warning

We have been watching the situation in Eastern Europe closely both internally and externally. Our concerns for both the future of Europe and that of the world itself are gravely put on full display by the actions of both your army and government, with Eastern Europe being the unfortunate victim of such unprecedented violence.

In addition, we have strong reasons to believe that your nation is willing to commit inhumane and despicable acts of genocide and violence against the victims of the conflict you have started. Let it be known that the United States and its allies, despite its bitter history with Germany and its allies, will not stand idly by if your army continues to deploy any prohibited weapons both on the battlefield and against the civilian populations of Europe.

There will be no further warnings from the White House.

Signed,{getpresidentfirstname} {getpresidentlastname}
strings.OMS_far_eastern.12.a: Tell that Nazi-loving swine to die like the rest of his Teutonic masters.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.13.desc:
TO: Glavkoverkh Yazov

FROM: Colonel Igor Rodoinov, Far East Command

Comrade Gavokoverkh,

The situation here in the Far East has changed dramatically for the worse. In addition to a significantly increased force concentration of Japan and its allies in the region, American air and naval vessels have been spotted training together close to our maritime border. These military exercises have been nonstop for the last week and a half.

We do not have much time to prepare further defenses in eastern Siberia. It seems both the American and Japanese are preparing to launch an attack by land, air and sea. We must assemble a force to guard any ports in the region and enough men to hold back the joint OFN-CPS invasion for they must not interfere with our Great Trial.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.13.a: Tell that Nazi-loving swine to die like the rest of his Teutonic masters.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.14.desc:
Igor hastily breathed deeply to himself as the last remaining Pakt forces hastily vacated the village. He quickly checked how many rounds were left in his magazine. He was almost out. The small community lay on an expanse of open ground without any natural defenses to protect them from the League's overwhelming fire. Trying to hold it was an invitation to be encircled as League forces pushed forward from all sides. That evening, he and his squad posted themselves in a mostly intact house to shelter for the night, intending to set up a forward post where the wounded could be triaged. But as they swept the building for booby traps that may have been left behind by the defenders, Igor found something curious just as he was ready to give the all-clear signal.

A three-string balalaika, in good condition, lay mounted next to an abandoned closet. A flicker of a smile crossed his face. He had one back home, and was quite well-practiced before the war. Perhaps he still had the knack to play a tune to lift some spirits? He picked the instrument up, and leaned against the wall, setting his rifle down next to him. Other squad members gathered around, curious to see if he could perhaps play something they knew. WIth a cursory strum to test the strings, he began to play.

To their interest and amusement, he began to play Kalinka. Starting slower in tempo, and singing along calmly. Even as the song grew more energetic, his fingers effortlessly glided across the strings. Not wanting a sudden and awkward silence to fall once the song was over, he immediately began again into Troika. He was already a decent shot and calm under pressure, but it was heartening to know that a little time could be found to put aside the horrors of war, and enjoy playing for and singing along with your comrades.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.14.a: For just one evening, the song drowned out the cacophony of war.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.15.desc:
Vladimir had faced the resolute and fanatical defenses of the Imperial Japanese Army, the Kwantung Army, and their American collaborators. But, despite everything, the Black Flag of Russia was hoisted above the city center for the first time since the Great Patriotic War. The combined forces of both the Sphere and its American allies threw everything they had at them, and Vladimir had been in the thick of it from the start. When the IJA first crossed the boundary into League territory, he had been summarily drafted from a backwater farm in rural Amur oblast. Now, he was part of an army bringing the Great Trialto Russia’s enemies in Asia.

Though his training was rudimentary at best, life under Yazov had taught him how to follow orders without question. Any other militiaman would’ve panicked when they experienced a stovepipe jam for the first time, but not him nor his comrades. They had learned far more from the harsh regimen back home than even a year in basic training could. Little wonder then that he and others rose to the challenge when called to do so, to mete out retribution upon the allies and their pack of ill-set attack dogs, and even those Russians who sided with them, their heads filled with lies about Yazov.

As a mark of honor for their courage in battle, Vladimir and his squad had been hand-picked to round up those who had thrown down their weapons during the waning hours of the battle. The Japanese, Chinese and Americans that had been herded into the city hall were as good as dead, but the Russian collaborators still held out hope that their shared nationality would e	arn them clemency. Time stood still for the captives as the Black Hand officer directed Vladimir and his men, and the order couldn’t be clearer
strings.OMS_far_eastern.15.a: No quarter for traitors,” and Vladimir didn’t hesitate to end them.
strings.OMS_far_eastern.15.b: You owe your lives to Glavkoverkh Yazov”, and Vladimir lowered his rifle.
strings.OMS_the_black_league_victorious_desc:
Since the days of Comrade Karbyshev, the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League has had but one purpose: the salvation of Russia through enduring the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. But this could never be accomplished while the Russian people live in squalor as a fractured nation, lost to the whims of petty bandits and warlords. Today, the first step to mending decades of destruction and violence wrought by the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon German Reich has been taken; Russia is united as one once more.

£GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Glavkoverkh Yazov will waste no time in shaping the very soul of Russia into a force for righteous retribution against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germanic Hordes. The people must be taught to honor the Three Theses and hate the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Hun that has stolen their Motherland. They must be devoted to the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial in body, mind, and soul. Our vengeance is in sight. Now is only the final days of preparation.
strings.OMS_black_boots_march_over_the_east: Black Boots March Over the East
strings.OMS_black_boots_march_over_the_east_desc:
When we returned to Siberia, we were under no false pretenses of expecting a warm welcome.  We fought from house to house and from field to field for the future of our nation, toppling the Eastern regime. But our triumph over the Siberian government has proven to be merely half the battle. Small insurgencies have already declared their defiance to the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Reclamation Government, becoming pawns in the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon German's game by fracturing our people. They must be taught the error of their ways, by force if necessary.

Commissars will pour throughout the countryside, into the East. They will cleanse the tundra of the rot and disease that has festered for decades until there is no remnant of the past or its failures within the vastness of Siberia.
strings.OMS_teach_the_people_hate_desc:
The common Russian has been lost, adrift in a sea of loss and torment for untold years. Some have known nothing but this life, many are resigned to their fate as part of a forever broken nation that can never reclaim its past glory. They have no sense of how much has been stolen from them by the Hun. If the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League is to be victorious in the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we must change the consciousness of the whole of Russia away from such fatalism.

The people must know the true breadth of the pain they endure. They must learn how the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon German has stolen their lives, their future, and their history. They must anguish over their Motherland's suffering, and emerge from their despair with a hardened heart and iron will to enact vengeance. The people will know their enemy, and hate him with the fury of hell.
strings.OMS_give_them_the_tools_they_need: Give Them the Tools They Need
strings.OMS_give_them_the_tools_they_need_desc:
The Motherland and its people have no shortage of willpower. As a nation, every man, woman, and child has faced countless atrocities and injustices. Russia is prepared to fight tooth and nail against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Hun, though our valiant nation lacks one thing: material.

We will provide the people with opportunities, in labor, in arms, and in production, to contribute to the war effort before it's even begun. We will begin massive infrastructure projects and construct factories across our land, we will give purpose to all from the youth to the veteran soldier, and we will prepare Russia for the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial with enough industry and equipment to shatter the Reichsadler hundreds of times over.
strings.OMS_everything_against_the_germans_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will no doubt be a costly endeavor. The wars to reunify the Motherland took enough of a toll to begin with, even when opposed by cowardly traitors and treacherous revolutionary scum. Now, we face a greater evil than any other that has ever soiled the earth's surface– one equipped with the means to wipe Russia's people from the face of the earth, and possessing intent to do so accordingly.

The fight will be strenuous and brutal, so we must utilize all of our Motherland in the war effort. Every chunk of ore, every piece of timber, every drop of petroleum must be sacrificed in the name of victory. We must use everything in Russia's arsenal for our righteous war against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich. From the Urals to the Pacific we must exhaust every deposit, bullet and soul in our crusade against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon National Socialist Menace.
strings.OMS_controlling_the_masses_desc:
One of the key contributing factors to the defeat of the Bukharinist Union was its inability to exercise total control of information over its citizens. Foreign propaganda materials and other agents of degeneration sneaked through our sacred borders despite repeated attempts to end the black market.

£GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Marshal Yazov and his loyal followers will make sure this mistake is not repeated. Every border pass and checkpoint shall disregard 'privacy', and all but official radios and television channels will be brought down. Such things cannot be afforded until Russia is safe from monstrous £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons!
strings.OMS_enhanced_interrogation_techniques_de:
Though we are no Bolsheviks, Trotsky once made an excellent point;

“If the end is just, so too are the means.”

The £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germans, inhuman scum, must be seen for what they are- a source of little more than hatred and information. There collaborators and assistants should be treated no differently.

The floors of our interrogation rooms will be littered with blood, teeth, toenails, and inhuman and human colors the eyes should not know. We will write volumes from the information we secret from the broken souls left behind from our £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Righteous crusade, and know the location of every building in the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich, as with their technology. Nothing will be safe from our eyes, and no man will be safe from our just wrath. Let our opponents cower.
strings.OMS_bolster_the_secret_police_desc:
When £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Omsk was a mere statelet in the backwaters of Western Siberia, the use of secret police to maintain our rule was necessary to ensure our goals were met with minimal resistance. As the shadow of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League has grown to engulf all of Russia, this has remained a fact.

However, as the new wardens of Russia, we can no longer act as if we are still a singular city and the surrounding tundra. The secret police will be doubled in size, as to properly oversee our newly-reclaimed territories. Our security apparatus must be next to none, for the enemies of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial are many and we are few.
strings.OMS_a_loyal_populace_desc:
Oh, woe be the lot of those poor Russians who were divided for so long. Kept under the thumb of weak, foolish men, our countrymen may find themselves confused by their new governments. Many have lodged complaints or queries, asking what the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is and why our new Russian society is so geared towards £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutonic reprisal.

Fortunately, we are here to illuminate them. Our new citizens will be given free re-education, as to integrate them with the rest of the populace. Soon, every true Russian will realise that their heart too burns with the desire for revenge. And those who don't? Well, then they were never true Russians in the first place...
strings.OMS_Together_desc: A Russian family should be modelled after the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon National Reclamation Government. The loving, strong father defends the family with his impeccable instincts and marksmanship; The caring, compassionate mother shelters her children from danger and teaches them skills necessary to survive; The children, candidates for £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon League membership, shall understand the responsibility they will bear as a Russian in defeating the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Nazi scum. Militarisation shall enter the household of every citizen!
strings.OMS_Reworking_The_Economic_Sector_desc: As much as £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Marshal Yazov wish to bring utter destruction to the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Nazi hegemon, he knows the costs of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. We cannot blindly smash ourselves against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germans till we are ready for it. A series of policies designed for rapid industrialisation will be carried out. In addition, we will also examine our budget and cut anything that is not strictly necessary. Every last penny ought to be struck into bullets if it can be spared!
strings.OMS_a_generation_of_rage_desc:
In preparation for the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, we cannot forget the importance and duties of our Motherland's youth. They cannot be neglected, lest they fail to realize the importance of our cause or dare gain sympathies with the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich. Children are easily swayed and their minds can easily be infested with £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutonic propaganda. Russia's future cannot be allowed to be corrupted.

Children will be taught of the crimes and history of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Huns, of their legacy as warmongers and savages that have done nothing for the world and are a cancer upon this Earth. They must know their enemy and the cause of Russia's woes. Let every child in Russia know that our enemy is the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germans and only the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germans and that their crimes have but one punishment: annihilation.
strings.OMS_spread_our_truth_desc:
Russians of Occupied Territories! Too long have you been oppressed by the Germania regime without a semblance of dignity. Too long have they stained our holy motherland, on which they have left many a scar. Too long have you stayed silent, kept shut by Nazi rifles and tanks. However, all hopes are not yet lost for our nation and our people. Under the command of the glorious £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Marshal Yazov, Free Russia is finally whole, but the national liberation of Russia has only just started!

Any valiant citizen of Occupied Russia not willing to let the Nazis ride on his neck any longer, Arise!
strings.OMS_the_black_league_listens_desc: Even in this hour, elements of dissent still linger in Russia. Many of the intelligentsia class have been known to oppose the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League's efforts to unify Russia into a singular war machine against the Teutonic horde in favour of personalistic, materialistic and selfish ideas like 'freedom of association' or 'right to appeal'. These are nothing but counterproductive to the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, and as such will be eliminated from our society. Let those crypto-Teutonics tremble, for every word that escapes their lips will be held accountable against them any time any where!
strings.OMS_the_tvs_will_run_black_desc: The Television is one of mankind's greatest creations, with abilities to propagate and spread information at a rate previously unheard of. The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League of course must seize complete control over mass media whenever a new form arises to ensure our nation and our people are not tainted by the profane and infectious propaganda of our eternal enemy. Of course, entertainment will not be completely off the screens to appease the population, but we must ensure every single pixel is purely Russian!
strings.OMS_the_factories_will_be_without_dissen:
The machines of Mother Russia might be less capable than what the West can produce, but all equipment is run by hard-working men, and no other nation on earth houses workers as dedicated as ours. However, spoiled by other warlord regimes, many manufactories in Russia are not standardised in terms of working hours and quotas. Even worse, cases of fraternisation amongst the management and workers contributed to our state-mandated guidelines not being followed. This of course must change.

If they do not comply, what they produce will send them six feet under.
strings.OMS_true_league_comrades_desc: The Russian Man is a man of great will, strength and wisdom. He knows that £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Marshal Yazov means no harm to any Russian, nor the Motherland that He defends every day and night for the sake of hundreds of millions. He knows the National Reclamation Government requires sacrifice not because it wants to inflict injury, but to rescue those yet under the Teutonic shadow. He knows the Army is harsh and unforgiving such that every soldier of the Motherland is as mighty as the mightiest of the Nazi scum. He knows the Secret Police patrols the street only to cleanse the spies and un-Russian elements of the society, such that one day, the Russian man may be able to exact revenge of terrible scale upon his most hated enemy.
strings.OMS_Expand_the_national_redoubt_desc:
Although the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League is quite familiar with the concept of fortification, we are not nearly doing enough. In case of £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon a nuclear war, which is likely to occur as our £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutonic enemies are ready to bring down the world with them, Russian people will be in a sorry state. Casualties will not be toleratable, and whether our race can exist after the £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon nuclear holocaust will be questionable.

The Ural Mountains, which have proved valuable during our wars of unification, shall be £GFX_OMS_national_redoubt_texticon thoroughly fortified as the Swiss did with the Alpes. Although we would not necessarily have used them for defensive purposes, sheltering a significant percentage of our nation will be invaluable if the war goes ill.
strings.OMS_A_True_War_Economy_desc:
In the West, Military-Industrial complexes are sometimes known to play a major factor in the economy, especially for superpowers like Germany and the United States. However, in these nations, their degeneration has resulted in these systems falling apart. The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League will not and cannot tolerate these mistakes.

Our militarised economy must be completely dominated by state-owned corporations by buying out every last privately owned factory in West Russia. Only then, are we able to clearly count, distribute, and swiftly liquidate any that dare to compromise our efficiency.
strings.OMS_Remove_The_Excess_desc: Much of Russia's economy is oriented towards various types of consumer goods. Although some are absolutely critical for our society to function normally, some are more of a luxury than what is strictly necessary. So long as any such instances of luxurious goods remain, we will remain disadvantaged against our enemy. £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Marshal Yazov will see to the elimination of this wasteful consumption in Mother Russia.
strings.OMS_Produce_Only_What_You_Need_desc:
A significant chunk of Russia's economy is still driven by agriculture, and both our regime and that of Siberia relied on exports of excess grain in foreign currencies. This practice however is now obsolete.

The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon League will systematically survey our agricultural production capabilities, and adjust them to a more fitting level. More farmers will pick up machine tools and produce £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teuton-killing grenades and rifle rounds rather than black rye. We will lose many to the war, and therefore Russia would have less and less need for food anyhow.
strings.OMS_Separate_The_Wheat_From_The_Chaff: Separate the Wheat From the Chaff
strings.OMS_Separate_The_Wheat_From_The_Chaff_de:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League demands nothing but the strongest faith and will from all it leads. Russia must be powerful, loyal and above all ready to serve the League at any moment's notice. We cannot accept weakness or take pity on the lesser of spirit. To beat back the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Huns, the frail and feeble cannot be allowed to hold us behind.

We will conduct a series of programs and evaluations set out for our citizens. They must be tested rigorously to ensure their loyalty and strength. We shall accept no inferiors into the battle against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon German without exception. Those who fail these examinations will be put to more... appropriate use. We will raise a legion of officers without flaw or infirmity, committed to destroying £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutonic decadence and evil.
strings.OMS_Boys_In_The_Factories_desc: Our motherland is wide, and with it millions of people inhabit it. Many of these people cannot fight to defend it, but there is a willing group that, whilst not being able to fight on the frontlines, may be of use to us producing the weaponry for use in our £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon final conflict. Children are on average more patriotic and more loyal to our cause than adults, if they are put to work in factories we may gain an upper hand against the menace to our west.
strings.OMS_Men_In_The_Service_desc:
The soldiers of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League defeated our degenerate enemies to the East relatively easily, but the Army should realise £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon our next competitor will be a lot more difficult to defend against much less defeat them. £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Nazis will likely have total air superiority, heavier tanks and numerous weaponry at their disposal. However, their pride in quality shall be the final nail of their coffin.

The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon League can and will field an army large enough to counter the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germanic horde. In addition, civilians shall be put into militia regiments for the purpose of observation and early warning across cities in West Russia. Only by completely covering the entire front and our cities with reservists may the terrible wrath of war remain on the borders.
strings.OMS_The_Fertile_At_Home_desc: The continuation of Russians as a sizable ethnic group is as important as eliminating the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutonic barbarians. If we are to lose all our men for the £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon project, then in fifty years our nation will be reduced to a state of widows and crones. We must genetically select naturally fertile women, who will play a crucial role in repopulation should it become necessary. In addition, the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon League will focus propaganda efforts and award productive mothers with honours, additional rations and publicity to increase our subpar birth rate.
strings.OMS_The_Rest_In_The_Army_desc: Some female members of our society are looked down upon by traditionalists for carrying 'masculine' features and are inherently less suitable for roles like housewives. This discrimination against useful members of the Russian nation must come to a full halt. We will assist these abled women to a more fitting career, one that will bring as much if not more honour to their family than any other males. Let the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons tremble before the battle cries of the brave daughters of Mother Russia!
strings.OMS_Technological_Advancement_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League of course will not be mindlessly sending our youth to pave the way to Germania with their own corpse. We will utilise what resources we have with maximum efficiency. When science is freed of its manmade shackles like 'morality' or 'consciousness', the power it can unleash will shock £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon our hated enemies to their very core.

The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League will also work on improving its weaponry by recruiting disgruntled foreign scientists rejected from achieving their dreams by concepts like 'ethics'. Let the raw power of the finest of the world befall upon the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons!
strings.OMS_The_Men_In_The_Factories_desc:
The practice of penal labour has existed since time immemorial, and in Mother Russia, it is almost expected for those charged with serious crimes. However, for the most part, prisoners committing more petty crimes do not face this gruesome fate.

This mistake will now be changed effectively. Though not back-breaking, all convicts will be put onto the assembly lines. Only through continuous work may these undesirable parts of our society redeem themselves, bread for bullets.
strings.OMS_The_Men_On_The_Front_desc:
War is coming. This is but a fact since our conquest of Siberia. As £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Nazi Germany may launch a pre-emptive strike at any moment, it is imperative for the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon League to remain vigilant against potential invasions from the West. And if we begin to mobilise then, it would be all but too late.

Harsher conscription must begin effectively immediately across the country. Only then will we have the time to train and harden Russian men and women into effective and blood-lusting machines of war.
strings.OMS_Expand_The_Bunkers_West_desc: While £GFX_OMS_national_redoubt_texticon fortifications in the Urals and Western Siberia are underway, we must not forget the actual frontline against the so-called Reichskommissariat Moskowien. From the White Sea to the Caspian, the borders shall be militarised to the uttermost. Every river crossing, every mountain pass, and every forest shall be defended by well-stocked comrades of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League, and the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons will learn to respect Mother Russia and her furious sons and daughters.
strings.OMS_lock_down_the_west_desc:
A key aspect of our victory over the Nazi empire is that we must have tight control over the movement of people across the country. It is imperative that we should meet with regional governors and ask them to keep the citizens where they should be at any given time. This way, we will be able to single out subversive elements and spies of the enemy, who will be swiftly dealt with.

To achieve this, curfews should be imbued into the routine of every Russian, and all unnecessary movements of people must halt at once. If any person can travel to a neighbouring town without official documents permitting so, then we will risk hostile infiltration!
strings.OMS_fortify_the_vastness_desc:
Our border with the illegal, disdainful German occupied territory of Moscowien is one of the longest continuous political divides in the world. Some would say that to attempt to garrison a stretch of Earth so far reaching in its entirety would be a fool's errand. Those who would claim such have never seen what the resolve of Russia can accomplish.

Extensive and vast lines of trenches and other defensive fortifications will be built along the length of the border. We will create our own Hadrian's Wall to defend our land from the scum that lay across the boundaries of our state. Not an inch will be left unprotected. By the will of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League.
strings.OMS_depopulate_the_villages_desc:
In order to truly prepare for the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, and inevitably annihilation of the Teuton, we must first prepare against the Moscow border. The villages along the border will be flushed out and replaced with soldiers. Now without the issue of civilians, we can prepare our defenses and effortlessly house our men in their cabins.

When the Teuton stumbles upon the frontier of our border, they will be met with nothing but iron and blood. Their beloved Panzer corp will be met with emplacements deep into the countryside, and rattle with the sound of our artillery.
strings.OMS_dig_the_trenches_desc:
Wartime mobilisation is not something alien to average Russians. Since the 1940s, the civilian population has been through trials of fire and blood, and so did the League. Though Soviet-era city designers placed settlements with national defence in mind, the war showed that simply placing down towns and expecting enemies not to reduce them to rubbles is childish.

Modern, total war demands greater sacrifice still, and we cannot repeat the mistake Bukharinists made that cost us our sacred motherland. Before the war starts, our soldiers will only march to victory if they have extensive trench and fortification networks to work with.
strings.OMS_a_safe_frontline_desc:
From the city of Michael Taxiarch to the shores of the Caspian Sea, the National Reclamation Government is finally ready for a potential clash with the Greater Germanic Reich. A curtain of steel, of concrete, of human flesh and will, hardened by decades of war and fueled by primordial hate has encased the dangerous borders between two nations destined to annihilate each other. Two nations with nothing but hate towards the other. Two nations, of which only one may stand victorious. It is either the total destruction of Barbarian Germany or us. There can be no mercy or hesitation. All is ready, and the loyal soldiers of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League await the orders of £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Marshal Yazov for what has been promised.

Revenge.
strings.OMS_To_Beat_The_Germans_desc: £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Our nation has made many sacrifices first to unify our country and now to beat the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teuton menace. We will neither bow nor bend not even break to the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Nazi scum but if we have to make the £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon ultimate sacrifice to save our culture, and our race from the threat we will. We will £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon scorch the earth until it becomes a desert and destroy their cities so their civilization will have felt the modicum of pain that they had inflicted on us all those years ago. We will win at any cost.
strings.OMS_We_Must_Use_Every_Advantage_desc:
The coming conflict will require immense willpower in every single Russian for us to claim the £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon final victory. Though our enemies are hardened by sadism and brute force, great still shall be our hate. Our spirit shall drive us, but the enemy will not be beaten off with simple courage. Instead, our army needs to learn to adapt to the environment they are fighting in, and our society will need to adapt to protracted warfare. Every citizen will know how to act when their food is appropriated for the front, and every soldier will know how to survive even in the most dangerous hours.

As for our government, we also need to press every advantage we can think of. Courting with the United States and false information will be necessary. After all, they did abandon us to the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Nazi onslaught.

It is what they owed us.
strings.OMS_All_Shall_Bear_The_Weight_Of_The_Wor:
Our culture has seen much suffering and decay since the First Trial. It has been belittled and scarred by the barbaric £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons in the West, infantile Kazaks in Central Asia, and the conniving Japanese in the Far East. In spite of all the chaos, a new, stronger Russia has arisen which shall see the culture of Russia reach heights that have never been seen before.

The evolution of Russian culture into a strong, dedicated force of vengeance and vengeance alone has begun to take root and is spreading far and wide. We must sustain this process, whipping and pushing and leading the Russian people into a cold, merciless that shall be the Teuton's undoing. The Russian bear grew dormant and almost perish, but now its roar will be for all on Earth to hearand to instill nothing less then pure fear of our power! Russia marches onward, first to the South, and will then turn West to complete its one and only purpose..
strings.OMS_the_infantile_kazakhs_desc:
The Kazakh & Turkmen nations of Central Asia, in their independence, have declined in their faithfulness. They have become uncivilized brutes, a nation of savages - those who desire nothing but money, who still remain faithful to the rotting, vile faith of Bukharin's system, and even those who emulate the Teutonic Menace. They no longer have any sense of personship, and they have abandoned in everything that is right, and true, in their world.

This must be changed. We will destroy these foolish, falsified emulations of 'nations', ending their corrupted system of raids and conquests - no longer allowing what is little more than tribes to try and raid the lands within our south. However, there is also an ulterior motive - the steppes near the German Border may prove to our advantage...
strings.OMS_quell_central_asian_nationalism_desc:
While some may fully believe in our ideas and rabid nationalism, a majority of those within the Kazakh Steppes will refuse our absolute truth. This is no matter. We will send the expansive units of spies and militarized police to destroy any dissent against £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Yazov's will, preparing against any potential insubordination to our south.

In turn, with our domination over the Kazakhs, we will have a southern frontier free for Russian population, be it through forced migration or ethnic landscaping. With the expansion of the Russian peoples, there shall be a second homeland, the second great Russian land, never to fall to the savages again.
strings.OMS_silence_the_steppes_desc: Historically, members of the Kazakh nation have been largely supportive of Russia. They have fought in many wars since the establishment of Russian Turkestan, and few have been Russophobic. The nation is still not beyond salvaging. Like us in Russia, what has been stopping Kazakhs from embarking on the same destiny is a subversive, rebellious minority of the Kazakh society. The only thing we need to do to correct the mistake is to obliterate our enemies and help our true friends.
strings.OMS_overhaul_intelligence_operations_des:
The Teutonic horde possesses a great intelligence apparatus, one that must not be ignored should we want to advance the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. It is imperative that we must ensure that we have the upper hand on the unseen battlefield. As we advance through the so-called Moskowien regime, we anticipate hostile sabotage efforts in their helpless attempt to stop the fury of Mother Russia.

Through a combination of domestic techniques developed since the late 1950s and foreign concepts, no Teutonic scum will escape the sight of £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Marshal Yazov!
strings.OMS_more_ears_on_the_border_desc: As the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial comes ever closer, there could never be too much preparation and information. Our sleeper cells, deployed into West Russia and Ukraine since we first reached the borders with Germany shall be put into action. No movement of German military personnel and materiel shall be made unknown from the hidden eyes and ears of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League. Only then may our holy war be a feasible military operation.
strings.OMS_found_the_sbo: Found the Statistics Bureau of Observation
strings.OMS_blacking_out_the_rising_sun_desc:
We have played nice with the Japanese for too long. They took part in the faillure of the First Trial, and have taken righteous Russian lands and added them to the pathetic basket case of instability that is called Manchuria. While plans have been drawn up for an operation to retake our lands and the port of Vladivostok by force, we can not afford to get trapped into a wider conflict with the Japanese Empire, for it would only ever distract from the affairs in the West which take far greater prescedence.

But we can not leave this flank exposed, should the Japanese get any ideas. Our East shall be locked down, fortified, and well defended to dissuade the Japanese from undertaking anything while the Great Trial is ongoing. Dependance upon and trade with the entire Co-Prosperity Sphere shall be ended, and from now on the Black League will stand guard in the East...while moving everything else towards the West.
strings.OMS_far_eastern_black_navy_desc: The Japanese have a formidable navy. Whilst we have likely inherited a small fleet from whatever statelet existed in the East, the Japanese fleet will massively overpower it. A programme of research and development into naval capabilities is therefore required to even ward off the possibility of a Japanese naval assault.
strings.OMS_siberian_redoubts_desc: Should the Japanese strike, they will almost certainly do an invasion using their Chinese lapdogs, as well as naval landings in the Far East. We shall cake the earth in their blood, should they try.
strings.OMS_expand_arsenal_of_vengeance_desc:
Our nation was badly scarred in our battles with the Teutonic beast and his cowardly underlings. Rich off of our resources that they stole and built by the hands of those they enslaved, the undeniable reality is that they eclipse our capabilities. This means that we have a lot of catching up to do if the Great Trial is going to be successful.

Now that the riches of Siberia have been reclaimed and with this urgent need in mind, we'll spare no expenses to designate and develop several cities for the express purpose of becoming the most advanced chain of research, development and production of NBC weaponry that mankind has and the means to deliver them on land, air and sea. When the time comes to march on Germania, we'll do so with an arsenal of weapons greater than anything the brutish westerner's feeble mind could even imagine.
strings.OMS_field_experiments_desc:
Large-scale experimentation and development of chemical weapons have been dormant for several decades and it's only recently that we've been able to resume large-scale R&D of these weapons that will send our message of hate to our enemies. Thankfully, our inhuman foes have rested on their laurels while we made strides in the field.

In future wars, our comrade soldiers will march into battle without having to rely on regimental support artillery to receive support from our arsenals of vengeance. We'll make these instruments of our national anger portable by the common infantryman, giving entire legions of patriots the means to corrode the bodies of our enemies just like they tried to corrode our glorious motherland.
strings.OMS_rehabilitations_desc:
Among those who fought in the reunification wars, there are many great heroes of the Soviet Union who proved themselves against the Teutonic hordes both in the Great Patriotic War. Some had their careers shattered in the Smuta, some even live out their days in our dungeons for standing against us in our struggle to reclaim all of Russia for the Black League.

Because of their abilities and the fact that they have - for now - killed more Germans than most in our own ranks, We're prepared to re-evaluate the records of some of these faded heroes of our Soviet past. They will be given a simple choice: pledge their loyalty to the sacred Russian homeland and its heroic Marshal ahead of the Great Trial, or rot in a jail for insubordination. We expect them all to make the right choice.
strings.OMS_delivering_our_message_desc:
Our beloved nation has been badly scarred in its battles with the Teutonic beast in the west and its cowardly underlings. With decades gone to waste, we have a significant amount of catching up to do in several key military fields. This would’ve been difficult in the past, but with the reclamation of Siberia’s riches, this is about to change.

Under our watch, we’ll spare no expenses to make sure that Russia’s waters will once again be protected by a mighty fleet. Our newly formed strategic rocket forces will allow us to rain death upon our hated enemy, their strikes made all the more potent thanks to our strides to modernize our NBC arsenal. Once the Great Trial starts, we’ll have all the tools we need to utterly vanquish the German people and turn Germania itself into a smoldering crater.
strings.OMS_the_great_equalizer_desc:
Rushed through development, Object 416 is finally ready for testing in the recently liberated deserts of Central Asia. Bearing the name of the Black League's founder, this weapon will be what allows us to erase Germania itself from history. A weapon so powerful that a single bomb eclipses that of the entire Teutonic arsenal, the mere mention of its name will strike fear into the hearts of the enemies of Russia.

If successful, we will finally have a weapon that can not only equalize the bomb and missile gap between us and our enemies, but will be enough to outright destroy the heart of the Teutonic empire with one fell swoop. Nothing less is enough to express our full hatred for the German.
strings.OMS_thousand_lakes_run_red: Let The Thousand Lakes Run Red
strings.OMS_thousand_lakes_run_red_desc:
Among the ranks of Russia's enemies, the perfidious Finns are often overshadowed by the greater evils that reside in Germania though their crimes against our people have endured for centuries. Always the eager servant of the Swedes, these barbarians were always the first line of defense against Russia's efforts to civilize the Nordic region. The current permutation of Finland is perhaps the most vile to date: a sanctimonious underlings of one of Germany's servants that committed ethnic cleansings of Russians in Karelia while pretending they were any better than the Germans.

The Finnish mockery of the Russian nation ends now. In what might become a dress rehearsal for the Great Trial, Black Hand operatives will enter the Land of a Thousand Lakes and turn them red with the blood of those that thought they could harm our people and go unpunished.
strings.OMS_operation_apraksin_desc:
It is high time that we started to rectify the historical injustice that is Finnish independence by force, bringing a final hammer blow to this cowardly lackey of the Teuton. Where the Union fell short in 1939, we will succeed today by unleashing a steel tide upon them from which they'll never recover. Once we do, the Teuton and any Scandinavian vassal at his disposal will surely rush to the aid of the illegitimate collaborator regime in Helsinki. Let them come - we'll simply destroy them and make the process of liberating Moscow simpler.

The inevitable military conquest of Finland is only the first step, however. Once their armies are crushed, we will crush the will of their people. What a hundred of years of Tsarist benevolence couldn't do, we will achieve within a single year. Once we're done, their will to resist won't just be broken - the entire concept of anything Finnish will be as well.
strings.OMS_in_bobrikov_footsteps_desc:
With the Finnish army and their Swedish handlers thoroughly routed, the time has come to solve the Finnish problem once and for all. The First World War interrupted and delayed more than half a century's worth of civilizing this wild wasteland that once was part of the Tsardom. The benign efforts of our ancestors were predictably met with violence, the only language that the Nordic peoples understand besides duplicity. The Grand Duchy has too kind to the Teuton's beasts of burden, a mistake that the Black League won't repeat.

If the liberation of Finland was a dress rehearsal for the Great Trial the pacification of the country will be a prelude for how we'll reintegrate the Kommissariats into Russia. We will station a full reserve army in Finland and stomp on the collective neck of Russia's enemies to the point where they will never be able to rise up again as a people.
strings.OMS_sharpen_our_swords_desc:
With the immediate tasks of rectifying most of our losses in the Great Patriotic War It's finally time to begin our final preparations for the Great Trial. The weapons of our vengeance will be the swift sword of retribution with which we'll cut off the head of the Teuton. Not only are we catching up with the Germanic beast in terms of firepower but technologically as well.

While we still lack a safe and effective method of deploying Object 416, thanks to our ongoing liberation of Russian lands we're now able to test missiles that give us the ability to strike within Germany territories on day one of our Great Trial. Once successful, these weapons of national vengeance can enter mass production and deliver convetional, chemical and biological payloads on their cursed soil.“
strings.OMS_a_war_to_end_the_germanic_menace: A War to End the Germanic Menace
strings.OMS_a_war_to_end_the_germanic_menace_des:
The Third Reich and its Nazi pigs have had one, and only one, enemy that has ever truly stood against them: the mighty people of Russia. It is our motherland that bled dry by tens of millions fighting against the Teutonic jackboot, it is our motherland that was enslaved and whipped, and it is our motherland that will beat them back and claim victory.

For all their posturing, the pitiful Organization of Free Nations and their pathetic ideals of democracy have never meaningfully aided in the sacred war against the Reich. Their peoples have not suffered for victory. They cannot know our struggle and our pain. We do not need them or their weakness. If we are to stamp out the Reich, it must be done ourselves.
strings.OMS_brutalisation_of_russia_desc: Even today, our nation bleeds because of past disasters. So long as Russian lives are maltreated in any form, the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League cannot call itself a defender of our country and people. Elsewhere in Asia, Slavic populations still face great prejudice from Central Asians and the Japanese. Ever have they worked to de-russify occupied Russian territories, and ever the brave partisans stood fast. Compared to the Germans, these are relatively less menacing threats that we can deal with to boast our strength and teach these traitor nations a lesson.
strings.OMS_we_are_ready_desc:
How much has our nation lost awaiting this moment? How many days, months, years have our people counted while the jackboot was pressed against their throats? How many tens of millions of lives were shattered? We have awaited this moment through suffering and endless time, and now it has arrived.

Everything has come to this. Every bomb and bullet which decided the fate of Russia led us here. For the first time since Voroshilov let it slip through his fingers, Moscow is once again in reach of its rightful countrymen. The city of lights calls out to us in this hour of reclamation. We must answer its cries.
strings.OMS_at_the_precipice_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon entire nation and everyone in it, no matter who or where they are all share the exact same feelings. Anticipation, determination, perhaps nervousness. But all are united in their determination to see the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon wretched Reich cast down, and the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon German menace which it serves £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon extirpated like so much rotten cancer. Every weapon is loaded and primed, every soldier at his post, and every plan signed off and prepared to fastidious detail. All that remains is the last handful of technical and logistical tasks to ensure every last piece is exactly where it needs to be.

The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is nearly at hand, for all the world to bear witness to.But it cannot be carried out until every last offensive plan is ready to be carried out at maximum efficiency, for maximum effect. We will ensure the opening stages of the war are as £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon devastating as possible to the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon enemy
strings.OMS_fill_the_peoples_fervor_desc:
How disconcerting would it be if the people you knew and were familiar with, your co-workers, neighbors, perhaps even your friends suddenly started raising a fresh hell? That is exactly our aim. We have slowly but thoroughly filtering agents into the RKs, and allowing them to settle into civil society there.
