Letting them appear as quiet, law abiding citizens beneath anyone’s notice. like buried explosive traps waiting for the detonation signal. Now the time has come to send that signal.

Seemingly out of nowhere, factories will be sabotaged, garrisons and police ambushed, and bands of partisans ready to conduct protracted guerilla warfare from the forests and hills. For the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germans, this ordeal will be akin to being flung into a pool of freezing cold water. Distressing, disorienting and agonizingly painful.
strings.OMS_march_towards_midnight_desc:
As the final preparations for the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Trial begin to see their end, the £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon final march towards the end of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon German race and their occupation of our sacred motherland begins. What remains of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Russian National Army beyond the Urals, protecting the frontier of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League's domain, are to be immediately called from their posts towards the border of the vile architects of our Motherland's misery.

The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Reclamation Government and its people stand at the precipice of fulfilling their destiny. The last hours of peace for the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons and their vermin race fast approach. The honor and duty of our motherland's brave defenders will bring about a new age, and the destruction of the Reich.
strings.OMS_arm_the_soldiers_of_the_reclamation: Arm the Soldiers of the Reclamation“
strings.OMS_arm_the_soldiers_of_the_reclamation_:
All the industrial effort into preparing for The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial has borne considerable fruit, with large caches of weapons, munitions and other war materials made ready for the oncoming war. But as there is no such thing as enough when dealing with such a well entrenched foe as the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich and their collaborator lapdogs. As such, one final great push of building up weapons for the war has been ordered. Factories will work on extended hours, every mine, every workshop that can be made to churn out tanks, trucks, guns and ammunition will be made to do so, and every able pair of hands will be made to work.

Even those who cannot stand at a furnace or lathe can be made useful in administrative tasks, as the large sums of material will need to be kept track of and sent to the right warehouses and supply centers. There will not be a single person who isn’t hard at work ensuring victory. Not one.
strings.OMS_doctrine_of_shadow_and_steel_desc: As the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will soon begin, we must make sure that every man knows his duty. We seek to not just defeat the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teuton, but to utterly and totally crush him. To do this we must use every method we have at our disposal. We will do to the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons what they once did to us. We will wage total war upon our enemy. Our officers must be willing to completely disregard the life of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teuton without hesitation, be they military or civilian. They must think of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon enemy as animals and treat them as such. Those who cannot do this will be sidelined. They are inefficient and useless to the architect of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. We cannot afford to have cowards in our nation’s most vital hour.
strings.OMS_final_offers_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League has prepared for this moment decades over. Our Glavkoverkh has dreamt of the glory that will come from this day. Every act and shred of will in all of our great motherland has pushed it towards its destiny. The time has finally come for the £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon last act of retribution against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Third Reich.

Our vengeance shall be swift. Our hatred and noble wrath shall boil over like a wave upon the enemies of Russia. The £GFX_OMS_national_redoubt_texticon National Redoubt facilities stand operational under the mountains, providing our people safety from the calamity that our sacred war will reap. The £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich shall be £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon burnt to ash.

Let vengeance be done, though the heavens fall.
strings.OMS_thus_struck_the_minute_hand_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League has prepared for this moment decades over. Our Glavkoverkh has dreamt of the glory that will come from this day. Every act and shred of will in all of our great motherland has pushed it towards its destiny. The time has finally come for the £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon last act of retribution against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Third Reich.

Our vengeance shall be swift. Our hatred and noble wrath shall boil over like a wave upon the enemies of Russia. The £GFX_OMS_national_redoubt_texticon National Redoubt facilities stand operational under the mountains, providing our people safety from the calamity that our sacred war will reap. The £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich shall be £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon burnt to ash.

Let vengeance be done, though the heavens fall.
strings.OMS_More_For_The_Soldiers_desc: Naturally, humans choose the profession with the highest earnings, and this will be exploited to assist in our conscription program. The army will be prioritised on every possible type of goods and provided with commodities that are otherwise hardly available to the general public. In addition, we will also provide similar benefits to the family of our soldiery. With their family in safe hands, more Russians will flock to the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League.
strings.OMS_Dig_Deeper_desc:
Russia is abundant with a myriad of natural resources, many of which are integral to a nation's ability to wage total war across the Eurasian continent. With our recent conquest of Siberia, additional strategic reserves are now available for exploitation. The defeat of our foe in the civil war proved their inability to completely master the art of harvesting ores, rubber, precious metals and wood for the war effort.

The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon League will export its efficient model to everywhere it may reach.
strings.OMS_and_the_league_knows_all_desc:
The League has cameras, microphones and informants all across Russia. The amount of information that we collect and process is beyond comprehension. All this is done to safeguard our Motherland, of course, by rooting out Teutonic sympathisers and other undesirable scum that plague our great nation. None shall stand in the way of our great Glakoverkh.

After all, one should not fear the All-Knowing Eyes and Ears of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League if one does not have anything to hide...
strings.OMS_and_the_league_is_secure_desc: £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Marshal Yazov watches over Russia's labours for her £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon one last historical mission. All across the nation lives have never been more secure from the Teutonic menace that has ruthlessly cut down our people. No longer will a Germanic spy find any information, for our lips are shut and sharp are our eyes. No Nazi brute will penetrate through our defences, for our countless guns and earthworks shall bury him six feet under. No more will the unity of our nation and our people be challenged, for £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Marshal Yazov, a loving father of ours guides Russia only towards victory. No more will the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League fear subversive sabotage, for the League is now with Mother Russia, whether or not she wants to.
strings.OMS_stronghand_the_americans_desc:
Whilst we see very differently from the Americans, we ultimately have common enemies of Germany and Japan. Japan stabbed us in the back in the 1940s, and whilst they aren't our main threat, they are historic allies with Germany. Japan has a surprising amount of influence inside the far-east, most likely due to the traitors in Magadan and Amur getting in bed with them, and as such the chances of them attempting to pull us into their sphere is only increasing, so allying with the Americans is the natural counter.

Ultimately, the Americans are pretty willing to support us due to themselves hating the Germans, but they haven't committed to destroying them like we have. We have learned from history, you cannot condemn someone out of a window.
strings.OMS_production_for_promises_desc:
The vastness of American wealth and what it could provide the League is almost immeasurable, yet it can be felt across the world. Stretching out from the economic core of the Americas, their capital swells the foreign market throughout the globe, of course excluding countries unaligned to American interests, naturally including our domain for many decades.

Today, however, we share vested interest in the return of our rightful Eastern land from Japan and the destruction of our western enemy in the Fascist Reich. Regardless of what changes to our relationship the Trial may bring, for now we stand aligned, and our benefit is theirs. Investment from the clueless Americans will nicely oil the machinery of our state and provide the capital to bring the Trial to fruition.
strings.OMS_show_the_world_japans_crimes_desc:
The atrocities committed by the Japanese since they crawled from their home islands are uncountable. Their barbaric hordes have facilitated disgusting denials of humanity across Asia, second only to the Reich. Nanjing, in Iwo Jima, in Sichuan, and most recently in Vladivostok; the Japanese vermin have shown their true colors of fruitless violence.

Our talented propagandists have an abundance of horror and destruction which can be used to our advantage and shown to the world. Soon, everyone shall come to hate the Japanese people as much as Russia has, and surely then they will not deny us the reclamation of our rightful land from the villains of the Rising Sun...
strings.OMS_pro_russian_propaganda_desc:
With the conquest of Kazakhstan being inevitable, we will show them the betterment of the average civilian's life under us. As long as they remain faithful to the league, a people of strength and devotion to our cause, integrating within the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League, they will gain greatness - they will gain money - and most importantly, they will finally destroy what has destroyed them.

After our propaganda is flown all throughout the Kazakh 'nations' - no longer will they remain loyal to the petty fiefdoms within Central Asia, no, they will defect to our banners en masse, whether it will truly help them, or not.
strings.OMS_a_flurry_of_armour_desc:
Even in this hour, some in former Russian Turkestan still oppose our rule. Thinking they can outrun us, many bands of mounted bandits roam the vast steppes of Kazakhstan. How childish. These strategies are only effective against backwater militaries, and Motherland Russia, now reinvigorated by her most loyal and beloved son - All-Russian £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League, is no such enemy.

Every inch of Kazakhstan shall be free of dissenting rebels. We will give our armoured formation opportunities for training that they can utilise against the Germans on the vast steppe.

Live munitions included.
strings.OMS_brought_by_noncompliance_desc: However, this is not to say Kazakhstan is free of any guilt. Since the collapse of Soviet Russia, Kazakhstan, along with other Central Asian republics, passed a series of anti-Russian legislatures aimed at reducing the influence we Russians hold in Central Asia, something that our forefathers centuries ago have toiled for. These people have clearly forgotten who uplifted them from poverty into organised cities, who taught them how to read and who brought the guns that they are using, at this very moment, to massacre our compatriots. This kind of behaviour must be corrected at once!
strings.OMS_a_war_for_national_reclamation_desc:
Through our collective efforts, the ruination of our beloved Motherland at the hands of the Teutonic invaders shall be avenged with ferocity and thoroughness the likes of which has never been seen before. When the Great Trial achieves its inevitable and final victory over Russia's foes, no one will even dare to utter the names of our fallen foes, let alone adhere to the wicked ideology that led them to their inevitable demise.

The war that lies ahead will be hard-fought, and in order to assure our success the Black League must make the utmost use of whatever allies that have earned the privilege of being redeemed alongside us.

All must come together to extinguish the flame of National Socialism once and for all, for those who do not heed the  call to fight are little better than those who collaborated with the enemy.
strings.OMS_cull_the_officer_corp_desc:
For all our efforts to remove the doubting and potentially dangerous and put the loyal and faithful in their place, there remains a stubborn, disparate few who have eluded us and yet continue to (even if unwittingly) spread seeds of doubt among the soldiers and officers. The old adage of a chain is only as strong as its weakest link holds true, and we must find these weak links, and replace them with stronger ones. It would not do to have weak hearts spreading doubt, which would be a lead weight on morale and organization.

Finding them is a matter of listening for these whispers of fear and uncertainty, identifying a suitable replacement and then shuffling them where they can do no harm. Be it as a pencil pusher, or out of the job entirely. Such backroom backstabbing is a dirty business, but necessary to build the strongest war machine man can organize.
strings.OMS_give_preference_to_the_faithful_desc: While ideally our top officers would share our moral convictions, this is not the case. Some foolishly hold ideals of democracy or freedom. While some of these officers may be skilled, they cannot be trusted with the fate of Russia. Only officers who are blindingly loyal to £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Yazov and the ideals of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League are fit to carry out this holy mission. These loyal men will receive promotions over those who don’t share our values. Some will say this will lead to a stagnation in the officer corps. Yet, it would be even more dangerous to let some pompous bleeding heart liberal hold the fate of Russia. No matter the cost, the ideological integrity of our officers must be upheld.
strings.OMS_with_the_torchs_blaze_desc:
Since we made the world aware of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, OFN affiliated agents have made furtive contact with us, offering covert channels for arms, munitions, intelligence and monetary support.. Most of these have proven to be very enticing indeed, and we have maintained contact with these assets. Now, it is time to cash in our chips. We will begin to requisition whatever weapons, funds and information can be made available to us, to ensure that the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is carried out without a hitch. Not everyone in the league is in favor of this idea, but to ensure our ultimate victory, we must swallow a little pride.

The OFN is known to have high standards for equipment of all types, and if American guns and dollars are what help carry us to victory, then so be it. Not a single one of our soldiers will go unarmed, not a single factory unfunded, and not a single battle planned without high quality intelligence.
strings.OMS_ready_the_silos_unseal_the_canisters: Ready the Silos, Unseal the Canisters“

Of the many projects undertaken in preparation for the The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, some argue that the arsenal of vengeance is one of our more important. It will no doubt give us an invaluable strategic and tactical edge against the armies of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich, and their collaborator lapdogs. To that end, we must move these weapons to forward positions. £GFX_OMS_chemical_weapons_texticon Chemical munitions will begin to be distributed to artillery battalions and mortar teams, and nuclear warheads will be loaded into their silos, and a suitable target planned. Their cities will vanish beneath a poisonous cloud, and that will only be the start.

Gas grenades and incendiaries can be assigned to infantry units, though some additional training and guidance will be necessary for the responsible usage of these weapons. The last thing we need is gas blowing back in our faces, and fires spreading out of control.
strings.OMS_posture_our_might_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_international_image_texticon world at large and indeed the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teuton menace believe we are little more than a jumped up warlord state, who are merely playing at being a serious presence on the world stage, and indeed a credible threat to the ever noisome Germans. Before The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial begins in earnest, we will martial every last serviceman in great parades and military exercises to demonstrate not only our numbers, but our ability to coordinate and equip such a large force all at once.

Our soldiers, our generals, our equipment. Our planes, ships, tanks and all our vengeance weapons will be put on full display for the world to curate. We will make it abundantly clear our intentions, and our ability to follow through. The £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germans and the £GFX_OMS_international_image_texticon rest of the world will be made to respect, if not fear us. Whether they like it or not.
strings.OMS_dump_the_rot_desc:
Our last attempts at negotiation with the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutonic Menace will be blunt and coarse. We will demand the complete and total liberation of all lands rightfully belonging to the Motherland, immediate deportation of all Germans residing in the freed territories, demilitarization and the permission of subsequent “retribution protocols” in the Prussian lands, dismantlement of the Germanic Fleet, and many such more necessary measures to be submitted and inked in our name. These demands, although obviously symbolic in nature, shall be sent for the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon decrepit, degenerated husks in the “Volkshalle” to flatly rebuff.

However, in the otherworldly event that the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Vultures do accept our ungodly measures, we will spare no enemy of the Motherland. Any German delegation that crosses our sacred soil shall step not one foot without the cold, piercing glare of our bayonets to greet them. If they cannot accept this reality, then we must make them ourselves.
strings.OMS_with_every_waking_moment_desc:
If The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial and all the struggle that it entails is to succeed, then the bodies and minds of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon entire nation, top to bottom must be focused on preparing both materially and theoretically. The farmer will grow good groups to mill into rations, the miner will extract ore to be made into weapons and munitions, and the generals and command staff will spend every waking moment meticulously planning every last step of the offensive, and all reasonable permutations. If you can work, if you can plan, you will be part of the trial. This will be everyone’s fight, and everyone’s victory.

The £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Germans and their puppets have fallen into complacency, and when the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Trial begins in earnest, they will be completely flat footed in the face of our advanced preparedness. Whether advancing unfailingly or presenting a stout defense, we will have plans on top of plans for every outcome, and the stockpiles to see them through.
strings.OMS_operation_alekseyev_desc:
The Japanese have hidden behind their walls of Bureaucracy and piles of plundered wealth long enough. The time has come for their tanks, their soldiers, their will, and their honor to be shattered. We will pierce their weak defenses, overwhelm each and every sentry, and reach our rightful Vladivostok before they can muster any puny defenses.

There will be no quarter for enemies to our great and sacred Russia. There will be no remorse, no resistance to our benevolent rule, no dissent within our ranks, and most of all nothing to deny us the organic borders of the Russian motherland. All in our way will perish, and in their wake a new Russia, strong and unbroken, will arise.
strings.OMS_deport_the_collaborators_desc:
For the forty arduous years of Japanese occupation of Russian lands, there lived a network of collaborationist traitors, seeping into society like rot, who sold out the interests of their people for personal greed or delusional hopes of preventing further retribution by their occupiers.

As the fist of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League comes to grip Outer Manchuria once more, we are in a position to rectify these evils. If these traitors to the motherland so desperately wish to live under the Japanese boot; we will happily oblige. Local garrisons are to be dispatched to the homes and families of known collaborators, to offer 'transport services' to the Japanese border. They have betrayed their homeland, and now the only place for them is with their barbaric masters.
strings.OMS_The_Great_Trial_tree: The Great Trial Against the Teutons
strings.OMS_The_Great_Trial_desc:
Thirty years ago, the heart and soul of our nation was burned to the ground by the Teutonic hordes. The failures of the First Trial nearly wiped the Russian people off the face of the earth, as the Aryan fought a war against not just our nation, but our culture and people. They sought to “cleanse” the earth of our brothers and sisters, and tore down everything we cherished in life.

The Aryan believed they had achieved permanent victory.

How foolish they were.

The white-hot embers of rage and sorrow forged a new Russia. One that would achieve total vengeance, no matter the cost. Every single man, woman, and child who was relegated to the cold embrace of a ditch, will have their blood-debt paid three times over. Our £GFX_OMS_final_war_texticon final victory over the scourge of Europe is at hand, as tens of millions righteously toil in factories, or march into our former homeland with one goal: The complete destruction of Germany by any means necessary.

We have waited many years for this moment, and now the hour is at hand where we may finally avenge the injustices of the past.

The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial has begun.
strings.OMS_The_Road_To_Moscow_desc:
Once, the city of Moscow served as the beating heart of the Russian nation. A beautiful city of lights and dreams we once proudly called our capital. In another world, it may have become one of the greatest examples of human achievement and progress in the world. But that did not happen, as the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons brutally ripped our sacred city away from her people, burning away all that was sacred, and placing its rightful inhabitants in chains.

Now, we stand at the gates of our once beloved city, ready to forevermore bring it into the fold of her people. And when we hoist our sacred flag over the spires of the Kremlin, we shall promise the world this:

Never again
strings.OMS_Will_Be_Paved_With_Blood_desc:
If one were to think about the consequences of our failure during the First Trial, the first thing that comes into the mind of the average Russian would be the countless faces of siblings, parents, and neighbors, each of them having been mercilessly slaughtered by the endless cruelty of the Teuton.

Now, we finally have the opportunity to return the favor.

Every settler and soldier will be met with the same fate as those who they once murdered en masse. At long last, total retribution and justice will finally be delivered to the so-called “Ubermensch”, and the sacrifices of our long dead comrades will no longer be in vain.
strings.OMS_Everything_We_Can_Use_desc:
It's only right that the wealth of the Teuton and those that willingly served under his yoke have what was theirs taken from them.

In order to maintain our offensive we must increase our efforts and get more supplies to the frontlines. Whatever we come across as we march into the Reich will be repurposed to further our military needs. Food, materials, vehicles - everything that isn't bolted or welded down will be used to further our march towards Germania. Specialist logistics units will also be set up to make sure that as much of these materials as possible get efficiently converted to easily be used by our forces. Additionally, penal units will be allowed to plunder the bodies of the dead to reduce the strain on our logistics system. Fortunately for them, there is no such thing as a civilian in this war.
strings.OMS_With_The_Leagues_Might_desc:
The Black League has made its mark on this world. We used to be seen as little more than a petty warlord in Siberia but have grown to prove ourselves to be the mightiest force of retributory vengeance that the world has ever witnessed. Our tanks have laid have smashed the Wehrmacht, our planes have flattened the Hun's cities and our men have trampled on the corpses of our fallen foes.

We must make sure that news of our rampage of vengeance across the European landmass reaches the eyes and ears of every Russian to bolster their resolve to redouble their efforts at home and fight with increased ferocity throughout our nation. And of course, as the sight of the devastation we've wrought breaches the censorship regimes of our foes, they will tremble in fear before us.
strings.OMS_With_The_Motherlands_Blood_desc:
Industry is essential in war, nobody can reasonably disagree with this. If you can outproduce your enemy then it doesn’t matter how fanatical and devoted he is. You can’t expect to win if your men aren’t properly equipped. To that end, the league has made the decision to drastically ramp up production. Implementing shift rotations such that factories and workshops can remain open and operating at all hours, as well as loosening some regulations to help the production lines run faster.

It will no doubt cause a great toll on not only the people who have to work in those factories, but the tools as well. No man or machine is unbreakable, but we will make sure their sacrifice in blood, toil, sweat and tears is worthwhile. We will take their tireless labor and make The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial a glorious victory for all to share in.
strings.OMS_Burning_Through_Supplies_desc:
To obliterate the greatest enemy Russia has ever faced, the Black League finds itself using the largest army that the Motherland has ever fielded. Doing so is putting an immense strain on our logistics grid, however, and if steps aren't taken it may not be long before our stockpiles start to run dry.

To prolong our army's sustainability in the field we're going to earmark a portion of our industry to fully convert to helping the supply chain with vehicles, supply shipments, food, uniforms and more. If a surplus is achieved once more, all of that will go towards our supply stockpiles in our subterranean living quarters throughout Siberia.
strings.OMS_Their_Fatherlands_Wealth_desc: While we have managed to lay waste to a large amount of our repugnant foe's cities and forces, we have yet to establish an organized department for repurposing the ill-gotten wealth of the Teuton. By more properly organizing a state body to administer the reclaimed wealth that the German people have stolen from the world we can use it to supplement our supply chain as well as bolster our home front situation.
strings.OMS_Who_Hasnt_Served_desc:
With our grand crusade against the fascist cancer in full swing, we expect our manpower reserves to deplete rapidly in the coming months. To assuage any future complications, we will scour all our lands and pluck every abled body man from every town and hamlet. From tenements in the city to cabins in the woods, we will ensure all of Russia’s men will shed every last drop of blood in Russia’s reclamation.

No matter the age, if you can hold a gun or move artillery shells, then it is an obligation to serve Russia until you're dead or dying. The £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons and their ghoulish collaborators will throw all they have at our frontlines, millions will perish from their machinations. We know the sacrifices that are to come, and we will be ready to replace every dead soldier with two more. All shall serve their great Motherland in her finest hour.
strings.OMS_What_To_Do_With_The_Settlers: What To Do With The Settlers?
strings.OMS_What_To_Do_With_The_Settlers_desc:
The greatest crime committed by the Reich was the so called “General Plan Ost”,an absolutely horrid plan with the goal of reducing our slavic brethren to nothing more than slaves, as the vial Aryan reaped the fruits and eventually fully replaced them. Now, these so-called “settlers” beg and plead at our feet for mercy.

We will only offer them suffering.

These criminals, who slaughtered untold millions for their sacred Lebensraum, will be given nothing but anguish. They shall soon feel the sting of the whip, the weight of chains, and much more.

However, £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Yazov has engineered his own additional method of justice. Every single Ost-Deutch within our hold will undergo a program of sterilization, forever eliminating the future of the Teuton while also keeping them alive as nothing more than fodder for our war machine.
strings.OMS_Accept_Nothing_desc:
It is inevitable that some Teuton “settlers” will have refused to leave their stolen homes and farmsteads. Perhaps some of them believe they can resist us. Perhaps some continue to hold onto the feeble hope that if they beg for mercy from the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League, they will be spared.

They are sorely mistaken.

There will be no mercy for the settlers. Not a single German will be spared. Any mewling attempts to appeal to a “better nature” will be met with the barrel of a gun. The stolen lands will be engulfed with gunfire, and silence shall only fall when the last of the National Socialist scourge has been removed from blessed Russia.
strings.OMS_They_Know_Their_Fate_desc:
They know our stance on their blood. Their barbaric culture and ideals. If they haven't left our homeland by now, they will feel the consequences. After all, they dare remain in our rightful homeland, even after everything they have done?

The Germanics shall run from the Eagle, or they will be eaten. Man, woman, or child, it does not matter, they will feel the hammer of righteous fury.
strings.OMS_No_More_Scum_desc:
Currently there are very few settlers left in our domain. Thankfully many were caught and prosecuted in whatever execution deemed right. But sadly we have run out of places to cleanse.

Now, we must reinvigorate the hunt of the Teuton in our land. Whether they have even one drop of Germanic blood they must be dealt with. The same stands with this Germanic “culture”. We will extinguish the light from every pair of Tectonic eyes on our soil, and bring ourselves ever closer to fully repaying our blood debt.
strings.OMS_Show_Them_Our_Hate_desc:
If the Teuton is to fully understand the fate that awaits them, we must instill the same degree of fear and terror that they once brought to our land. And we will show it all for the whole world to see. Executions, ruthless beatings, and lashings will be broadcast to the homefront, so that all may gaze upon the fulfillment of true justice.

Our divine justice and triumph of our national peoples over the lowly Germanics shall be put on full display. We shall show their men die, their women suffer, and their children starve.

And nothing but thunderous applause will reign out.
strings.OMS_Anger_Is_A_Strong_Tool_desc:
Hatred is a beautiful emotion. No other invokes such strong, visceral reactions within humanity. It is pure - and the purest form of hatred in the world is that which we hold towards Germany. The age-old bitterness of the oppressed finally getting the chance to lash out and wreak vengeance on their oppressors is one that we will harvest and fashion into a weapon.

Hatred makes men hit harder, run faster, fight harder. It is good, and we will use it against the Teuton and his allies. Our primal rage will see Germania reduced to a blasted heath, its people scrambling away in fear for dear life in the exact way our people have for decades. They will know suffering as we have known it - for our hatred is far greater than theirs.
strings.OMS_Fear_Beats_Willpower_desc:
They will see exactly what we have in store for them. Our land was assailed and beaten by the Germans. Every damn square meter has been defaced by the Teutonic menace. Families were upturned, cities sacked, and futures burnt down. Now it is our time to scare them.

We shall mirror what they have done to us onto them. They will see their families upturned, their monuments defaced, and their cities sacked. These truths will be mass-produced and broadcast to the world. Soon the world shall carry our fury.
strings.OMS_Expand_The_Target_List_desc:
The common soldiery of the Teuton expects our wrath, therefore they do not fear it - at least, as much as they should. The Fuhrer knows that one day he will nought but ash in the wake of our crusade. He fears us, but less than he should. This is not enough. The German people do not fully grasp what is upon them. Therefore, it is our job to remind them.

The list of military targets our soldiers are to capture and kill on sight shall be expanded to include greater non-combatant populations. Regardless of gender, age, or social strata, each and every German has benefitted from the suffering of the Russian people, growing fat off of our pain like some great collective tick. No more. They will, for the first time in their lives, know true fear.
strings.OMS_Hanging_Judge_desc:
In this Great Trial comrade Glakoverkh Yazov is the highest authority of justice. It's he who presides over the great halls of justice that is the endless Eurasian battlespace and it's he who will dispense justice upon the enemies of Russia and it is the Black Hand that will deliver the swift sword of our retributory justice to the hearts of the enemy societies.

Found collectively guilty, our operatives will begin to assassinate leaders of their societies. From managers to mayors to marshals, we'll spread terror throughout their societies and cripple their ability to function as a cohesive national body for as long as we fight them. They're all guilty and the sentence is death.
strings.OMS_No_More_Strings_desc:
The contacts in the Reichstag and beyond have grown middling and have given unneeded results. We have asked enough of these valiant people and their sacrifices were not in vain, we will make sure of it. They will be remembered as one of the many hammers that broke down the licentious German Eagle.

Besides we do not need to seek more knowledge of the enemy. For we already know what they are, the filth that needs to be cleaned off the surface of the planet.
strings.OMS_No_Matter_How_Long_It_Takes: No Matter How Long It Takes...
strings.OMS_No_Matter_How_Long_It_Takes_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial drags onward, as the successful conclusion we'd been hoping for continues to elude us. The “Aryan” Menace has clung as hard as they possibly could. But that is to be expected with cornered rats, for they bite and snarl because they know we are their superior, and that they will be permanently extinguished.

Every. Last. One Of Them.

The Russian Eagle is finished toying with its prey, and now we shall finish it off.
strings.OMS_We_Will_Win_desc:
needs new loc - Blooboory 

We have to win this war. For the sake of those who laid down their lives, and for the complete realization of the motherland's destiny, every Russian knows it.The corrupt showa bureaucracy in their pagoda knows it. The Americans know it, crammed in their office buildings and homes. The damned “Aryan” menace, the pest we shall kill, knows it. Then why would they be running? Why would they hide behind nuclear payloads and diplomacy? If this war must go on for thousands of years then let it! If the last humans on Earth are a German and a Russian, the Russians will always win! The vile and futile German will always lose.

We are better than they will ever be.

The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will be fulfilled, no matter the cost.
strings.OMS_hung_jury_desc:
The Great Trial has reached an impasse. Despite our best efforts and our intense preparations we now find ourselves in a state where our forces can only advance with the most extreme difficulty imaginable as the bulk of the army has run out of steam after months of relentlessly advancing with more intensity than any fighting force ever has in history.

If the Great Trialis to resume and be successful, we must take urgent measures - lest all our efforts will be for nothing more than a botched mistrial
strings.OMS_yazovs_grace_desc: Marshal Yazov will not respond to the crisis like a barbaric Teuton, but with the calm and grace that Russia deserves to see from its leader at this moment. They will see him not as a tyrant demanding the impossible, but as one that is leading by an example worth striving for. The airwaves in the trenches on the front and shelters at home will see him taking the situation with a robust steadiness that makes him the living embodiment of Russia's collective stoicism./n/nWhatever may happen behind the scenes, our propaganda will make sure that this is what all Russians both at and behind the frontlines will see and believe.
strings.OMS_yazovs_fury_desc:
The situation is inexcusable. For the so-called soldiers of the League to stumble just as we're so close to finishing our task of national annihilation against the Germans is a crime in and of itself. We will make sure that the message will go out loud and clear to all of Russia that their marshal demands that they fight with redoubled vigor. The rage we all feel over the attacks on Russia will be channeled through Yazov, the living embodiment of Mother Russia's rage at those that slayed her sons and daughters.

Anyone that doesn't give it their all in this time of crisis, whether it's at home or directly at the front, will be dealt with harshly by the Black Hand, the instrument of comrade Yazov's justice.
strings.OMS_throw_them_a_bone_desc: Our officer corps quite justifiably expect heads to roll over the fact that they've nearly caused the Great Trialto end up like the First West Russian War. We should use this to our advantage./n/nThey will expect the worst, and we will make the believe that the worst is neat only to mercifully be saved from the abyss by their benevolent marshal whose kindness and understanding is the only reason that they can live on to fight another day. At the end of the day, everyone in the officer corps whose nerves have been wavering as of late will be made to make commitments to Yazov himself and redouble their efforts in the war.
strings.OMS_make_an_example_desc: Those who betrayed Russia and the soldiers under their leadership rightfully fear what is in store for them. We will make examples of them and show these inept fools that they are not above punishment. Anyone that isn't indispensable attached to units that have underperformed will immedeately be put under investigation./n/nThe Black Hand will investigate the officers in short order and anyone found guilty of criminal neglect in the line of duty will be sentenced for treason. In recognition of their service, we will give them two options: they can be put in front of a firing squad, or spend the rest of the war shoulder to shoulder with German POWs captured by their more successful peers.
strings.OMS_fresh_blood_desc:
Within the lower ranks of our officer corps are many former Red Army officers that used to serve their Motherland with dignity and were allowed to re-enlist in our army as we swept through Siberia and liberated Russia from those who failed the Motherland. Given the failures of our own generals, the time has come to re-evaluate these officers and give them a chance at redemption.

More importantly than the skills they bring in, these officers are being given a second lease on life and they know it. They will be thankful to the Glavkoverkh and ensure that more ferocity is brought to the table within our officer corps. Because if they don't, they know that they may very well be back at square one again - or worse.
strings.OMS_with_renewed_vengeance_desc:
It wasn't just the soldiers that failed to reduce Germany to ashes, but the so-called leaders who were supposed to lead them to victory. They had grown soft and complacent following the reunification wars and now their men are paying the price, as is the rest of our sacred Motherland. We cannot let this injustice stand.

Under the potential penalty of torture for any failure, we are to make sure that each and every officer that wishes to serve comrade Glavkoverkh Yazov is reminded of their duty and the costs of not succeeding. Brutality may be the only language Germans understand, and we'll make sure that our officer corps will become more than fluent in this kind of expression - or else.
strings.OMS_pierce_the_veil_desc: The much-touted Great Stall as the foreign press has dubbed it has turned out to merely be a Great Regrouping of our forces, one that has allowed us to become even stronger than we were before. The moment of imperfection is over and now we stand ready to unleash a more perfect form of vengeance against the Germans./n/nNow the time has come to unleash our perfect hatred upon the Germans. Across the European battlespace millions of courageous Russians stand ready to once again advance with renewed vigor towards our foe and deliver a new, complete cleansing of their barbaric homeland. It's time for us to kill, and it's time for the Germans to die./n/nOur Great Trial begins anew.§
strings.OMS_Black_League_Childrens_Authority_des:
The next generation of Russians have been educated as to the evil of the Teuton - we have seen to that. So by that logic, now that the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial is finally upon us, how could we in good consciousness deny them the right to partake in it? It is their birthright, in their very blood. The children WILL serve their motherland.

In what way this happens will depend on a case-to-case basis. Some will help by serving in the factories, making bombs and bullets. Some will be sent to the front-lines as an auxiliary force, manning machine guns and carrying equipment. Regardless, our children will make us and our ancestors proud - just as we are.
strings.OMS_The_Bottom_Of_The_Barrel_desc:
Disaster! Our evaluation of the stockpiles has shown that they are almost entirely worthless! Most of the weapons no longer function, if they ever had, and the rest malfunction in ways that would only endanger us. Heads will roll for this incompetence on display, but before, we must remedy this or else all of our work to find victory in the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial will have been wasted.

To get our men resupplied, we must turn to what little equipment is left from the Great Patriotic War. No matter how ancient the gun, if it shoots, a soldier will wield it. We have no choice if we wish to salvage our logistics. The will of our men will have to be enough to overcome these shortcomings.
strings.OMS_Improvised_Tanks_desc:
It is a meticulous process to make a tank. Numerous parts and components are needed to assemble such machines of war. But in such dire times like this, we need no such “armor” or “alloy” for a tank to be sufficient.

We shall do fine with strapping our emplacements on top of cars and making vehicles just as effective as their armored counterparts. The Germans may think this gives them an advantage, but they do not understand that all we need to achieve victory is discipline and bravery. In the end, we will ensure quantity while leaving the quality aspect to the crews.
strings.OMS_Partisans_Arise_desc:
From the hills of Brest to the shores of Samara, they have trained for one sole thing. They have fought and died for the death of the Teutonic overlords, those who have shackled their fellow countrymen.

Arise ye humble Partisan! Arise to shake this very theater and open holes in the Germanic lines. Soldier or Partisan, the Teuton will learn to fear a follower of the League.
strings.OMS_No_More_Equipment_desc:
The stream of equipment has gone dry. Our bountiful harvest of weapons and equipment for the soldiers has stopped abruptly. When we started this war our coffers were full and ready to help dispatch the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons, but now it lay destitute, with no possibility of full replenishment.

We now have a new task ahead of us, to preserve the weapons that we hold and use them to the utmost effectiveness. With what we have left, we must conquer.
strings.OMS_an_unmeasurable_anger_desc: What the fuck is going on with our army? We have trained for years to tackle the Nazi beast. Our men were supposed to liberate Moscow!? We sit on our laurels already won, our sons and daughters under the Nazi jackboot are crying out for oppression. Our army is a fucking joke. Cowardice and treachery runs through the veins in our army. Cowardice is a stain that dirties our reputation and it must be cleansed if Russia is to be saved.
strings.OMS_call_for_immediate_reformation_desc:
The impossible has become possible.

The Gears of War have stopped, with the rot and filth of bureaucratic inadequacy. As our men freeze in the holes they dug outside of Moscow, the public grows antsy at our continual progression of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.

£GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Comrade Yazov has called for the nation to hold steady as we prepare for a long winter, many things will change in our stead. Many facets of our society will be upturned and changed for the better. These are changes we should have made long ago.

Ten years of progress will be made in Ten Weeks.
strings.OMS_replacement_desc:
The Teutonic scourge has downtrodden our high command and military apparatus to the point of ineptitude, but degeneracy does not solely affect the internal workings of the state. It branches out, hoping to destroy traditions we have held precious to us for hundreds of years, to render society into decadence.

If we do not hope to see ourselves fall like the empires of old, then we shouldn't implement myopic solutions. A replacement must ensue, getting rid of incompetency in our ranks and ripping out the tendrils of Teutonic degeneracy from society. A message must be driven into the minds of every citizen, one of courage and ability.
strings.OMS_in_the_people_desc:
With a population as widespread and numerous as ours, it can be difficult to gauge the common mood, which can vary widely from city to city, village to village. But, we must make a concerted effort to ensure that every single man, woman and child of all ages, everywhere and all at once has their full dedication to Yazov, the league and The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.

This will consist of an all out propaganda effort, with nonstop radio broadcasts extolling the virtues of Comrade Yazov and the glorious £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League. Pamphlets stuffed into everyone’s hand, newspapers with headlines shouting to all who’ll read them about the evils of the Teuton, and how Yazov and the league are our only way to defeat them once and for all. Not a single soul, from the streets of Omsk, to the wastes of Omolon will fail to support us wholeheartedly.
strings.OMS_increased_security_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial takes precedence over everything else, and as such, it is only natural for the Russian people to give their all to see it to its conclusion. Men and women will serve - day and night - in our many factories to fulfill the many needs of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League.

But some short-sighted and naive fools have begun protesting our heavy-handed requisition of material and institution of long work-hours. This has caused a wave of dissent to disturb the solidarity of our nation and our Great Cause, it must not be allowed to continue.

Already we have received reports of riots at key infrastructure which has disrupted our war effort to a substantial degree. In order to curtail this threat, we will have to send out the most loyal men in our army to secure vital military and industrial complexes and give them orders to arrest and gas protestors and should a full-scale riot break out… they know what to do.
strings.OMS_trust_no_one: Only One Enemy, Only One Goal
strings.OMS_trust_no_one_desc:
The people are the sheep and the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League is their shepherd. They are unable to see the bigger picture and are too short-sighted to make good decisions for themselves. The people are foolish and think that their actions will do them good when it will only bring our nation to ruin. But no matter, the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League exists to guide the misguided.

The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League is the only entity worthy of trust in Russia, more so than neighbours, friends, even family. And as such, they should not trust the words of those that surround them, for how can sheep tell lie from truth? Only the League is wise enough to know the truth, to know what is good for Russia, only the League can bring salvation to us all.
strings.OMS_smoke_out_the_rats_desc: The conundrum of internal security can only be addressed by knowing those who seek to undermine and overthrow the League. The panopticon of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League shall catalog every dissenter and back-stabber who leaves their footprints in the sand, as we hope to secure the homeland situation in order to focus our efforts on the armed struggle against the Teutonic marauders. We already have an extensive list, it matters not a few thousand more traitors are found and dealt with.
strings.OMS_in_the_army_desc:
We have done much to ensure material and practical preparations for The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, but much still remains to be done. Specifically, we must ensure the utmost and unwavering loyalty of the soldiers and staff. From the field marshal down to the private, we will instill the brand of fanaticism needed to drive the noisome German all the way back to his lair. This will consist of several components, the first being designing a training regime for both privates and officers commissioned and non, that saturates them in propaganda, taught by existing hardliners.

This can be mixed in with drill and assault practice, and even lighter elements like having shooting and bayonet targets be in the shape of German soldiers. Finally, and to ensure that this conditioning sticks in the hearts and minds of the men, is to encourage them to echo these sentiments amongst each other. The hatred of the enemy will resonate through every squad, every regiment, and every division.
strings.OMS_only_the_loyal_desc:
Our officer corps quite justifiably expect heads to roll over the fact that they've nearly caused the Great Trialto end up like the First West Russian War. We should use this to our advantage.

They will expect the worst, and we will make the believe that the worst is neat only to mercifully be saved from the abyss by their benevolent marshal whose kindness and understanding is the only reason that they can live on to fight another day. At the end of the day, everyone in the officer corps whose nerves have been wavering as of late will be made to make commitments to Yazov himself and redouble their efforts in the war.
strings.OMS_may_eat_from_my_hand_desc:
Those who betrayed Russia and the soldiers under their leadership rightfully fear what is in store for them. We will make examples of them and show these inept fools that they are not above punishment. Anyone that isn't indispensable attached to units that have underperformed will immedeately be put under investigation.

The Black Hand will investigate the officers in short order and anyone found guilty of criminal neglect in the line of duty will be sentenced for treason. In recognition of their service, we will give them two options: they can be put in front of a firing squad, or spend the rest of the war shoulder to shoulder with German POWs captured by their more successful peers.
strings.OMS_of_bullets_and_teeth_desc: An inept and clumsy army will only ensure that our efforts against the Reich will fail. Incompetence will be dealt with by correcting those men whose only contribution to the struggle is to worsen the state of the military, whether that means re-education, transfer, or in the case of desertion, death. The army will be forced to answer only to the League, and any dissent or mutiny will be dealt with accordingly. Soon our armed forces will know not to bite the hand that feeds them, for we’ll reciprocate even harder.
strings.OMS_in_the_generals_desc:
Within the lower ranks of our officer corps are many former Red Army officers that used to serve their Motherland with dignity and were allowed to re-enlist in our army as we swept through Siberia and liberated Russia from those who failed the Motherland. Given the failures of our own generals, the time has come to re-evaluate these officers and give them a chance at redemption.

More importantly than the skills they bring in, these officers are being given a second lease on life and they know it. They will be thankful to the Glavkoverkh and ensure that more ferocity is brought to the table within our officer corps. Because if they don't, they know that they may very well be back at square one again - or worse.
strings.OMS_to_be_feared_desc:
We have long left the days when we were but a small rump state in Omsk behind, but it appears that we have not left behind the corruption and nepotism that our high command once had, before we purged it from our nation with blood and steel.

Our security officers have notified us of instances where high-ranking officers and officials have utilised their influence and power to syphon off resources meant for the war effort and for the construction of infrastructure to enrich themselves.

The Glakoverkh is unsurprisingly - furious, and has given orders to arrest these decadent bastards and trial and execute them for treason. We are close to our goal, none will stand in the way of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial's success. If we have to put a bullet in between the eyes of every single corrupt official and officer to instil a fear of disobedience into those that might be tempted to reach for things they should not touch.
strings.OMS_and_loved_desc:
Marshal Yazov will not respond to the crisis like a barbaric Teuton, but with the calm and grace that Russia deserves to see from its leader at this moment. They will see him not as a tyrant demanding the impossible, but as one that is leading by an example worth striving for. The airwaves in the trenches on the front and shelters at home will see him taking the situation with a robust steadiness that makes him the living embodiment of Russia's collective stoicism.

Whatever may happen behind the scenes, our propaganda will make sure that this is what all Russians both at and behind the frontlines will see and believe.
strings.OMS_all_feelings_no_words_desc:
It wasn't just the soldiers that failed to reduce Germany to ashes, but the so-called leaders who were supposed to lead them to victory. They had grown soft and complacent following the reunification wars and now their men are paying the price, as is the rest of our sacred Motherland. We cannot let this injustice stand.

Under the potential penalty of torture for any failure, we are to make sure that each and every officer that wishes to serve comrade Glavkoverkh Yazov is reminded of their duty and the costs of not succeeding. Brutality may be the only language Germans understand, and we'll make sure that our officer corps will become more than fluent in this kind of expression - or else.
strings.OMS_a_trust_in_the_process_desc:
Our Glavkoverkh, £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Dmitry Yazov, is the one man in Russia who can claim to truly be directly responsible for the triumphs of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League. Who was it that ended the factionalist, greedy reign of the old guard? Who was it that brought the League to rule indisputably over the vast lands it administers? Yazov, and Yazov alone.

Just as it would be foolish and arrogant to deny the Glavkoverkh recognition of his successes, we can not turn our backs on his judgment. Unwavering faith in his methods and theories will bring the Black and League and Russia its salvation. Any other means or leadership would be entirely futile.
strings.OMS_random_acts_of_patriotism_desc:
The greatest weapon of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League on the homefront of Russia remains its loyal citizenry. Regardless of those that seek misplaced harm to the cause of the Trial, a strong support base of the everyday people of Russia remains ever present throughout the nation, a fact we can exploit against these misguided dissenters.

Rewards to those that take a personal hand in exposing the rats within Russia will be distributed across the nation. Any information that results in the capture of Anti-£GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League agitators will be given significant rewards, including increased rations for up to a month. All we'll have to do to watch the opposition crumble is sit back and watch.
strings.OMS_see_my_beauty_desc:
Russia is a sweeping land. Taigas, mountains, cities, spanning from Siberia to the West. And throughout all these lands, there are no men greater than Russia's very saviour - £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Dmitry Yazov. He took the reigns of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League from Karbyshev and made haste in finishing the work that his predecessor had neglected, once again uniting Great Russia under one banner.

And now, there is no one who can challenge him anywhere in the world. From Washington to Germania, these men are nought but ants in comparison to the titan that is £GFX_OMS_dmitry_yazov_texticon Yazov. And soon, all of them shall know. We stand on the precipice of finally fulfilling The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, and it shall only be through the work of the Supreme Marshall!
strings.OMS_decades_of_stagnation_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial has thrusted the world into an unprecedented nuclear holocaust– as Glavkoverkh Yazov and the All-Russian Black remain silently under the shadow of the Ural Mountains, they wait out the pervasive atmospheric firestorms, ionizing radiation and harsh nuclear winter that envelops much of the world.

He and the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League are determined to resurface, to unite all of Russia under a singular banner once again and bring vengeance to the pervasive, scheming £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons that managed to escape the grasp of the Trial. It is a necessity to Yazov that the shortcomings of the Trial be redeemed, and that what remains of the Nazi government and party chancellory be entirely eradicated, by any means necessary. Yazov looks west, determined– hoping to embark on an expedition throughout what remains of Eastern Europe, in order to end the Teutonic blight once and for all.

But, despite his determination and the League's willingness to proceed, a myriad of issues stand in his way. Among the high saturation of ionizing radiation and environmental phenomenon on the surface, a substantial amount of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League high command is dispersed across numerous nuclear shelters situated in major cities and other strategic regions. The Glavkoverkh finds himself without the vital resources and manpower required for crossing into central Europe, compounded by the scarcity of supplies and unrest within Yazov's territory. The future of the League looms in a dismal cloud of uncertainty, and only time will tell if it's able to continue its legacy.
strings.OMS_the_dead_lay_above: The Dead Lay Above Our Feet
strings.OMS_the_dead_lay_above_desc:
The cowardly £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons have dealt a crippling blow not just to the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League, but all of human civilization. While our society lives on beneath the Earth, the world we know above has been eviscerated in the fires of war.

Hundreds of millions lay dead at the hands of Germany. The citizens of Russia we so-fervently sought to liberate are but ashes across the irradiated soil they lay upon. The world's countless cultures and histories are but a fading memory within the anarchy that has consumed them. A millennia of civilization, gone in a flash.

The £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons shall pay for their crimes. That, our Glavkoverkh will make sure of.
strings.OMS_trapped_in_an_infernal_game: Trapped In An Infernal Waiting Game
strings.OMS_trapped_in_an_infernal_game_desc: It is abundantly clear that our bravest and most ingenious tacticians are starting to break under the strain of bunker life. Whilst this is a great and noble trial in and of itself, we must find a way to keep them preoccupied to ensure that they are ready to do whatever is necessary when the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League finally rises like a Phoenix from the ashes. Some activities and solutions proposed in breaking up the monotony include sending scout teams to investigate the outside, surprise drills to keep the generals' minds sharp as well as increasing the amount of rations they could get each month. We shall run through each of these solutions as we wait for the radiation levels to decrease, maybe even doing all of them at once given the luxury of time
strings.OMS_thoughts_of_the_past_desc: The people yearn for the bygone days of the Soviet Union. Back when the peoples of Europe and Asia were united as one. We shall use this nostalgia to our advantage by creating films regarding the heroes of the West Russian War and the hardships endured by the average Soviet citizen under Bukharin's rule. This will show them that the former Soviet Union was weak and that the bygone days would have been exactly as they remembered it had the old union's leadership been stronger. These films shall pave the way for our citizens to be more open to enduring the hardships of our £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial and prepare them for the challenges ahead. With all the time we have to wait out the radiation, we have enough time to ensure these films send our message clearly.
strings.OMS_when_the_kitchens_were_full_desc:
To think that so many things we took for granted before this £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial are a luxury now. The fresh air, the clean water, the morning sun and most of all, the ripe harvest and livestock that fed our people. Those days seem so far away now, the memory of a bright summer day now being a distant memory to our loyal citizens.

Perhaps it would be good to lift up the people's spirits by making creative use of our rations. We shall conduct a survey to look for culinary experts in these bunkers and have them make recipes out of the rations. These recipes shall evoke the memory of the pre-war days. It should help break up the monotony and ensure that our population remains healthy and happy. Whilst this is not enough to keep our people motivated, it should serve as the backbone to our strategy of surviving the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial.
strings.OMS_when_the_army_was_decadent_desc:
There once was a time when the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League was an unstoppable force. Our great nation stood amongst giants and could easily crush any that would oppose it. Our logistics and firepower were near second to none and we were able to stomp out the Teuton menace for good. Nowadays it is a shadow of its former self, left rot while we wait for our return to the surface.

We must ensure our army is ready to fight at any cost. Surprise drills and inspections should keep our soldiers on their toes as well as keep our general's minds active. We shall do our best to simulate the conditions that our men might face on the surface once we emerge, despite the limited space within our bunkers.
strings.OMS_when_the_people_had_purpose_desc:
The purpose of every £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League citizen is to work towards the destruction of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons. But ever since the supposed end of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons, the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial has been reduced to a mere waiting game with much time and little to do. The resolve of our citizens is waning and they are beginning to question their purpose for living in the first place.

We must help them endure this £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial by reminding them that there is much work to be done to reclaim the motherland and that they must prepare intensely. We shall run educational films that shall instruct our citizens of the industries and infrastructure that must be rebuilt once we emerge from the surface. Every citizen shall be trained rigorously in construction, agriculture and radiation cleanup so that the reclamation of the surface will be smooth and easy. Our £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial isn't over and the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League must be ready for whatever comes next.
strings.OMS_new_league_in_new_age: New League, In A New Age
strings.OMS_new_league_in_new_age_desc:
To all, it is clear that the reclamation will require great change within the society of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League. If we are to maintain our current state, we would simply become yet another decentralized warlord, a nation of sedentary peoples, no longer a great Russian nation, but a nation of cowards, and liars.

With this, we prepare for yet another great change within the society - from men and women living their sedentary lives within the various bunkers, to once more a culture of war, a people dedicated to our true goal once more, no longer necessitating the League abandon what it was meant to do, once again becoming a Spartan Machine, all united in the goal of the End of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons.
strings.OMS_changes_needed_desc:
It has become apparent that our first reforms have succeeded, yet, there is a need for more. Yazov is still not pleased with the affairs - many of his own men are still slacking, and lazy. There is still rot to be purged from the ranks of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League, before even another thought of destroying the savages within the SS is given. Not until every man serves - every man is faithful - and every man truly believes in our cause, can we rise across the entirety of Eurasia once more.

A fundamental shift in our new society must be made. We have lived too lavishly without the threat of the teutonic beasts on our back, we have spent years sloughing within the bunkers, losing our devotion to the cause. We were foolish. The old order, and the new, cannot be allowed to continue, lest Omsk fall to the demonic creatures which we had once wiped away.
strings.OMS_sacrifices_made_desc:
Throughout our lands, inside our bunkers, a rot seeps into every crack in its walls. We took every precaution to cleanse our tools of national salvation of the filth that permeated throughout our nation, but these traitors and degenerates are like cockroaches. They have survived the bombs but they will not survive us.

Cleansing our bunkers of these rats is to become the first priority of the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League. Every crevice and nook must be inspected. The enemy cannot be allowed to persist a second longer. The rot will be cleansed. The League will endure. The traitors will be dealt with by any means necessary for the survival of our Motherland.
strings.OMS_stunning_silance_desc:
Initial reports from our forward scouts have revealed a gradual dissipation in radiation levels, finally permitting our League access to the surface again. It is time for our citizens to finally put into practice their reclamation training, slowly taming the desolate wasteland we once called our home. These measures will include the construction of localized checkpoints outside of Omsk itself, rebuilding armament workshops, and forming a civilian sector so that we may create a functioning economy once more.

In time, our Motherland shall stand as a beacon of justice and civilization amongst the ruins of the old world—a land of strength, industry, and martial peoples.
strings.OMS_matter_of_clarity_desc:
All the dominoes have fallen. Every single event that was meticulously crafted day and night by the Glavkoverkh has successfully gone all to plan one way or another, the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial has brought itself to its inevitable conclusion. All the fighting and bloodshed could end, all the hatred towards the Germans; it was all over, and Yazov couldn't feel any emptier.

With who we thought were the last remnants of the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Teutons now dead in the snow, Yazov has prepared to leave the bunkers himself to face the hellish reality he himself has brought upon not just the citizens of Germany, but the whole world itself.
strings.OMS_once_more_into_the_breach_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League stands at the precipice of reclaiming the motherland and destroying the Teuton menace that lies beyond. It is, therefore, necessary to create new staging points by modifying our existing bunkers into strongpoints, allowing us to wreak havoc on our enemies without worry of reprisal attacks.

By repurposing old redoubts into supply hubs and checkpoints, our engineers and logistics officers shall become the bedrock of our next generation of soldiers. These new warriors, hardened by the harsh, unforgiving wastes we call Russia, will surpass even the Spetsgruppa in determination, with our strongpoints following them every step in the way.
strings.OMS_form_new_regiments_desc:
It is a tragic reality that many of our brave comrades were eviscerated in the climax of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial. However, that shall not stop the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League in continuing the fight. From the men we saved to the next generation, we shall bring forth new divisions that will revive our strength—perhaps forging an army even stronger than before.

This new force of the League will be more than capable of bringing the wastes to heel. Our loyal men shall know no fear as they march and redeem our fallen warriors for the good of our Glavkoverkh.
strings.OMS_break_open_the_caches_desc:
Our beloved and treasured motherland lies under a coat of nuclear ash, with her industries either obliterated into dust or picked apart by scavengers. With our Glavkoverkhs' preparations to reclaim our country now underway, we must tap into our vast underground arsenals to prepare for the oncoming national struggle.

In preparation for our great advance into the unknown, the League has managed to stockpile a grand array of equipment acquired during our conquests, ranging from antiquated rifles to howitzers and armor. While these expansive stores cannot be expected to last forever, we can only pray that what, who, or what we find,does not exhaust our depots before the national vengeance can begin anew.
strings.OMS_salvaged_tanks_desc:
Reports from our advanced groups of scouts have brought astonishing news from the surface; collections of pre-war armored vehicles have been found intact within the vicinity of the Omsk Bunker, and are in good enough condition to be salvaged and eventually returned to service.

The tanks vary greatly in make and origin, with some bearing the mark of the Teutonic hordes, while others remain as shells of our fallen comrades, still lingering around our capital in a stasis-like trance. While the rehabilitation process will take some time, the prospect of fielding armor on the battlefield once more greatly entices our new breed of warriors.
strings.OMS_our_chemical_arsenal_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League shall retrace the steps of its fallen comrades and march once more into Western Russia, cleansing the land of chaos and anarchy just as they helped to cleanse the motherland of Germanic tyranny. We must rearm and support our soldiers as they prepare to cross into the unknown to achieve this. The next step in finally destroying the Teutonic beast necessitates the reconstruction of old railroads, depots, workshops, and the trains needed to transport our soldiers into the Wasteland for us to begin the great reclamation.

Once our army's necessary infrastructure is complete, we shall drill our next generation of men into the patriotic warriors of old. Nothing shall be left to chance. Russia will be saved, lest the Teuton tendrils return like a blight upon our Motherland.
strings.OMS_underground_workshops_desc:
The Germans, in one final attempt to preserve their decrepit Reich from our touch, wrought the fires of the atom upon the lands of Russia. They believed in our destruction. They were wrong. Under the unbreakable will of our Iron Marshal, the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League fights on from the depths of the earth, waiting for the chance to once again unleash our wrath against all who oppose us. In due hours, our armies will bring swift justice to the surviving roaches who still infest our homeland. bringing vengeance to those who doomed our Russia to a decade of anarchy.

In the meantime, however, all is not well underneath the desolate surface. Food has begun to run scarce within the cold, isolating walls of the Omsk Complex, and disloyalty has once again begun to creep back into our ranks. We must address these pressing issues eventually, but for now, our League survives. Its steel heart is still beating strong in the face of the apocalypse.
strings.OMS_control_the_heavens_desc:
Our army grows stronger day after day, but they are nothing but walking bodies and scrap metal if our mortal enemies retain mastery over our skies. It is thus pertinent that the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League must scavenge as many planes from the wasteland as we can. Be it the simple biplanes of the bygone Free Aviators or the jets of our fallen comrades, we shall recover them and reclaim the skies just as we reclaimed Russia on our path to glory.

With our planes dominating the skies once more, we shall ensure the destruction of our enemies and bring unbridled fear wherever they roam. For as long as our League hunts the clouds, the bandits and traitors who inhabit our lands shall fear the Sun like a divine blight.
strings.OMS_Leagues_Heart_desc:
The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League has forged a generation of steel through fire and blood, a manifestation of the League's unbreakable will in the face of hardship. Like a well-oiled machine, our soldiers must be prepared to crush anything that dares to oppose them in the radioactive vacuum outside our reach. While much of our army was scattered and destroyed during the climax of the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial, a new wave of recruits have arisen to fulfill their martial duty.

While some cadres of men may require more, 'patriotic instillment' than others, we shall forge the chaff into a core of iron. Hard times require strong men, and the next generation shall serve as the tip of our spear in the reclamation of Russia.
strings.OMS_remind_them_of_their_duty_desc:
Like the aging guns buried deep within our soil, the resolve of our citizens has slowly rusted away during our time beneath the surface. Some question our stringent food rationing and the necessity of our martial law, others dare to slander our Marshal and even the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Great Trial's purpose. They will be reminded of their place in our Bunker.

We shall summon a new wave of heroic propaganda aimed at all sects of our society. Whether it's the young or the old, all shall serve and fight to bring justice to the motherland and our fallen comrades. When Germany's stench is wiped from the earth, they will know true victory. Until then, we shall fight.
strings.OMS_the_eagle_will_fall_desc:
Neither death nor Hell can stop the £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League's righteous cause in securing redemption for our ancestors. For too long mortal weaknesses such as plague, hunger, and greed have chained us to our pain. Enough of this! Russia will never know peace for as long as the Teuton's memory endures. We survived the power struggles, we survived the Unification Wars, and we will survive the fires of Satan.

No longer shall our suffering blind us from our true purpose. Whether it takes years, decades, or centuries, we shall stand alongside our Glavkoverkh until our flag waves above Germania for good.
strings.OMS_no_matter_the_cost_desc:
The day of prophecy has arrived! Our army stands ready, our citizens are motivated, and the Glavkoverkh holds firm. With the wastes desperately waiting for their liberation, we cannot afford to wait any longer.

Just as our ancestors crossed the border into Moskowien so long ago, we will enter the underworld and complete our mission. Now, or never
strings.OMS_chemical_weapons_gui_info_tt:
We may be working on producing considerable stockpiles of WMD's, but our stockpiles of our other 'Weapons of National Vengeance' ready to be used at the warfront is a very different matter...

Decisions on the top right tab of the GUI allow you to fill your stockpiles. The more weapons we have, the longer we will be able to utilise them on the frontlines. We can also initiate further stages, which upgrades our chemical and biological weapons at the cost of the weaponry's stability. If the weapons become too unstable, engaging them in war will result in us also being hit by the weapons. To stabilise the weaponry, you can utilise the bottom right tab of the GUI.
