Click to view decisions on this state.
strings.OMS_2WRW_grand_offensive_stratagem_decis: We'll divert extra resources from our storages for a grand general offensive in the spirit of comrade Glavkoverkh Yazov himself.
strings.OMS_2WRW_ceaseless_assault_stratagem_dec: Our commissars will instill into our soldiers the patriotic fervor needed to charge relentlessly towards the enemy and never stop until all opposition has been obliterated.
strings.OMS_2WRW_chemical_saturation_stratagem_d: Additional planes, artillery and rockets will be made to carry chemical payloads. A cloud of chemicals will sweep away the Germans as our men march behind it.
strings.OMS_2WRW_firestorm_assault_stratagem_dec: The Germanic disease will be eradicated by a storm of fire that will burn down his forts, his homes, his dreams. As scorched earth greeted the enemy when he marched into our Motherland, scorched earth will greet our men as they lay waste to the Teuton's nest.
strings.OMS_2WRW_strategic_repossession_theorem_: Rather than destroying all that lays before us, we'll temporarily slow down our offensive to requisition non-combatant assets within or zones of control. The ill-gotten riches of Germany will thus go straight to our war chests.
strings.OMS_2WRW_expropriate_assets_non_combatan: The non-combatants will have to learn to live with less. Cars, fuel, food, metals and even the clothes they wear is better needed at the front lines. Our commissars will scour cities to make sure that our patriotic laborers contribute to the war effort.
strings.OMS_2WRW_expand_labor_force_decision_des: The non-combatant segment of the population knows that there is no such thing as too old, young or sick to work. They must all do their part for the war effort. If they will not face death on the frontlines, they will do so in the workshops if need be.
strings.OMS_2WRW_propaganda_saturation_decision_: Our people will read about the triumphs of our army and see for themselves the annihilation our army is causing the enemy on their screens. Day and night, the music of victory will be their companion.
strings.OMS_2WRW_crush_defeatist_sentiments_deci: Even as victory is at hand there are still those who would prefer humiliation beneath the German jackboot over doing their part to achieve final victory. The Black Hand will bring them into line.
strings.OMS_2WRW_find_additional_volunteers_deci: There are many people across the nation who have not volunteered for military service yet, often laboring under the misconception that they're unfit to serve or can serve the Motherland better at home. Our security forces will scour the countryside and cities to find these men and help them volunteer.
strings.OMS_2WRW_readiness_construct_siberian_re: We will construct more networks of underground fortifications on top of the ones we already have in our Siberian strongholds, ensuring that more of our people survive the inevitable.
strings.OMS_2WRW_readiness_construct_finnish_log: The reclamation of the old Imperial capital of Russia will be second in importance only to the recapturing of Moscow once we embark on our Great Trialagainst the Germans. The barbardic Finns, however, built their Karelian logistics grid around the foolish idea of retaining their ill-gotten spoils of war. Let us instead repurpose it for the liberation of Russian lands.
strings.OMS_2WRW_readiness_construct_nikolaigrad: It isn't enough that we turned the den of vipers known as Helsinki into a Russian city. Our work isn't complete until we integrate it and other key cities into our national redoubt. It'll ensure that the new Russian citizenry will survive the aftermath of the Great Trial as well as make any Teutonic attempt to strike back at us completely futile.
strings.OMS_2WRW_readiness_construct_establish_b: We've been denied access to the Baltic Sea for three decades and it's about time that the Black Fleet made its presence felt here. By constructing new naval facilities here we'll be able to reclaim our naval legacy on this region. With it, we'll be in a position to strike directly at German cities in the north once the Great Trial begins, shattering any illusions their so-called civilians may have that they'll be safe from our wrath.
strings.OMS_2WRW_readiness_construct_western_red: A large portion of our population and industry currently reside in western Russia. Lacking strong natural defenses, it's imperative that we build fortifications to protect our factories and laborers from enemy strikes and, in the worst case scenario, serve as forward frontline bases if the enemy breaks through our lines.
strings.OMS_2WRW_readiness_construct_far_eastern: Far beyond the reach of Germany's bombers, the Far East will be a major strongpoint for the rebuilding of our society after the Great Trial is complete. By creating additional underground redoubts in these areas, we'll ensure a future for our nation long after the bombs fall.
strings.OMS_Separate_The_Wheat_From_The_Chaff_id: Seperate the Wheat From the Chaff

The war against the Teutonic Menace demands the strongest, purest individuals within Russia to be of service to the Russian National Army.

The Army shall not dare be infested with any perfidy or ineptness that'll dismantle all adroitness present within the League. No excuses.
strings.OMS_the_men_in_the_factories_idea_desc: All undersirables rotting within the cells have unpaid debts. They shall be repaid, rightfully so. Each and every one of them will be assigned to the factory lines. No exception can be made to a man of crime.
strings.OMS_the_men_in_the_front_desc: Harsher conscription methods must be utilised across Russia if we are to protect the Motherland from the Menace. It is a pure, warranted obligation to mobilise and train every man and woman for the War. Nothing more than an essential obligation.
strings.OMS_the_great_trial_desc:
The time is now. Our sole purpose, the defining moment in the history of Russia and her people, has arrived. We have prepared for many years, and hammered the heart and soul of our nation into a machine capable of finally bringing the end of the Teutonic horde. Millions toil in the iron arteries of industry as millions more march forward into our former heartlands to finally avenge the countless millions who were slaughtered.

 The Great Trial, has begun.

strings.OMS_cull_the_officer_corps_desc:
As the final days before the Trial pass, they bring with them rigorous inspection of Russia's armed forces, and it's become clear that traitors and their petty “ethics” seep into every crack in the Motherland, sabotaging the Black League's war effort.

The rot which has infested the Russian National Army must not be allowed to persist. Any who are not willing to carry out their assignments to the fullest extent must, by any means necessary, be relieved of their duty.
strings.OMS_cull_the_officer_corps_2_desc:
As the final days before the Trial pass, they bring with them rigorous inspection of Russia's armed forces, and it's become clear that traitors and their petty “ethics” seep into every crack in the Motherland, sabotaging the Black League's war effort.

The rot which has infested the Russian National Army must not be allowed to persist. Any who are not willing to carry out their assignments to the fullest extent must, by any means necessary, be relieved of their duty.
strings.OMS_every_waking_moment_desc:
The Great Trial demands nothing less than complete devotion to bring the vast might of Russia to bear against the Reich. Each cog in the machine of the Black League will turn the great conveyor of vengeance.

There can be no rest for Russia's citizenry, be it in the factories, the farms, or the fields of combat. For every man, woman, and child who dies in service of their Motherland, another five hundred must take their place. There is no cost too high for our retribution.
strings.OMS_march_to_midnight_desc:
The final moments of peace for the Germans and their vile race come ever nearer to an end. In accordance, the Russian National Army must be ready to march onwards at a moment's notice, unimpeded and in a single stroke, bringing hell to the Reich.

Preparations for such a large coordinated assault cannot be made at the last moment. The soldiers of Russia must be recalled from the frontier of the League towards the calling of destiny and retribution against the Hun, ready to enact their vengeance.
strings.OMS_pure_black_doctrine_desc:
The Red Army had many shortcomings, lack of weaponry, poor command structure, outdated equipment. But none were as obvious as the poorly planned, poorly executed tactics being used. It was first put on full display in the war with Finland, losing hundreds of thousands of men for what was a tiny gain in land, ultimately. And in the war with Germany we lost even more, whilst losing half of our country… An absolute disgrace.

Never again.

The Black League's top strategists have been at work making new strategies, new plans. Whilst taking the lessons of our wars of unification and the lessons of foreign conflicts, we have rebuilt our army from the ground up. The Russian National Army has become an iron fist ready to take on any challenges that threaten our motherland, including the trial ahead. It has the equipment, the will, and the manpower to finally destroy the teuton once and for all.
strings.OMS_apocalypse_proofing_desc: We intend for this to be a war to their annihilation, not ours. All pieces of key infrastructure in Russia are to be built partly or fully underground, designed to function after the nuclear bombs fall. This will make construction costlier but will ensure that our people will survive the Great Trial and inherit the earth once the job is done. In the event that an enemy should strike Mother Russia itself, our soldiers can make ample use of these shelters and tunnels for protection.
strings.OMS_vengeance_against_the_occupant_1_des: The hatred for our enemy is a perfect hatred, one which no one can ever hope to resist. As we liberate more of our sacred homelands and eventually lay waste to our enemy's filthy hovels, anyone who tries to stop us qill meet a fate worse than death.
strings.OMS_vengeance_against_the_occupant_2_des: The hatred for our enemy is a perfect hatred, one which no one can ever hope to resist. As we liberate more of our sacred homelands and eventually lay waste to our enemy's filthy hovels, anyone who tries to stop us qill meet a fate worse than death.
strings.OMS_vengeance_against_the_occupant_3_des: The hatred for our enemy is a perfect hatred, one which no one can ever hope to resist. As we liberate more of our sacred homelands and eventually lay waste to our enemy's filthy hovels, anyone who tries to stop us qill meet a fate worse than death.
strings.OMS_vengeance_against_the_occupant_4_des: The hatred for our enemy is a perfect hatred, one which no one can ever hope to resist. As we liberate more of our sacred homelands and eventually lay waste to our enemy's filthy hovels, anyone who tries to stop us qill meet a fate worse than death.
strings.OMS_operation_alekseyev_category_desc:
Although a diversion from the Great Trial, there are still Russians living under Japanese occupation in Manchuria. They must be brought back under rightful Russian control so that they can do their part in taking down the western beast. Everyone must do their part. Their ancestors dereliction of their duty to their nation is no excuse.

The operation is rather simple. We must take the designated area of land and hold it against the inevitable counterattack. We can spare one short-term allocation of additional supplies to bolster our efforts in the region, but no more. It was all go towards the Great Trial itself.
strings.OMS_attack_manchuria_desc: The terrain in the Far East is cold, and treacherous. The fight will not be easy. Be prepared.
strings.OMS_skirmish_buff_desc: More assets will be sent to reinforce Operation Alexseyev. We cannot spare much more than this. Everything has to be dedicated for the Great Trial.
strings.OMS_manchuria_buff_desc: The current border operations in the Far East have been reinforced.
strings.OMS_great_trial_desc: The moment we've prepared for has finally come as we embark on our GREAT TRIAL to smite the Teutonic beast once and for all. Time is of the essence however, as a drawn out conflict will strain our society. Should our people falter, we'll have to take extreme measures to ensure our final victory over the hated Goths.
strings.OMS_great_trial_offensive_momentum_desc: With each strategic victory, the Black League grows stronger as it marches on Germania for our final victory. Should we be pushed back to the national redoubt, however, the consequences will be SEVERE.
strings.OMS_we_stand_at_the_precipice_of_our_fin: We stand at the precipice of £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Our Final War against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon Reich, though some last preparations must be made…
strings.OMS_rapidly_escalate_arsenal_of_vengeanc:
We will begin to rapidly escalate our £GFX_OMS_chemical_weapons_texticon arsenal of vengeance...
The Chemical Weapons GUI will become inaccessible!
strings.OMS_any_means_necessary: The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Black League will use any means necessary against the £GFX_OMS_teutons_texticon menace of the Huns, though some will not have the stomach...
strings.OMS_posturing_might: The £GFX_OMS_black_league_texticon Russian National Army will put on one final display of its might before the £GFX_OMS_great_trial_texticon Trial
strings.OMS_our_agents: Our agents in Moskowien will finally commence Operation Chernobog
strings.OMS_chemical_weapons_gui_enabled_tooltip: We will build an £GFX_OMS_nuclear arsenal capable of burying the Teutonic threat forever...
strings.OMS_the_time_is_now: At long last, the Reich shall be wiped from the earth as we begin the Great Trial!
strings.OMS_sending_them_gifts: We shall send the Teutons a gift.
strings.OMS_activate_weapons:
BIOLOGICAL WEAPONS WILL BE UNLEASHED WITH THE FIRST SHOT OF THE WAR!
CHEMICAL WEAPONS WILL BE UNLEASHED WITH THE FIRST SHOT OF THE WAR!
strings.OMS_in_bobrikov_footsteps_tt:
We'll destroy the very concept of the Finnish in due time. Once the bulk of the work is done, Finland will once again become Part of the Russian core territory.
In the meantime, we can expect a notable strain on our infrastructure
strings.OMS_chemical_warfare_dynmod_desc:
The Great Trial has begun and the Black League has already made its opening move. In massive bombing campaigns, chemical weapons have been deployed in both our cities and on the frontline en masse. The effects are already taking a toll on our country and our ability to defend ourselves from their aggression.

Their weapons are indiscriminate. For every one of our soldiers that's killed, an equal number of civilian lives are taken. The Black League has set the scene for this war already:

This is a War of Annihilation.
strings.OMS_biologic_warfare_dynmod_desc:
The Great Trial has begun and the Black League has already made its opening move. In massive bombing campaigns, biological weapons have been deployed in both our cities and on the frontline en masse. The effects are already taking a toll on our country and our ability to defend ourselves from their aggression.

Their weapons are indiscriminate. For every one of our soldiers that's killed, an equal number of civilian lives are taken. The Black League has set the scene for this war already:

This is a War of Annihilation.
strings.OMS_nuke_pc_tt: Are you sure about this? Your game will die
strings.OMS_trigger_le_end: Trigger the End of the Fucking World
strings.OMS_2WRW_end_It_all_tt: Nuclear weapons will decimate the frontlines as we unleash our arsenal.
strings.OMS_2WRW_end_it_all_desc: Unable to achieve a conditional victory, we will simply redefine our win condition to denying our enemy a victory today so that we may fight and annihlate him tomorrow.
strings.OMS_failstate_3_tt: But for Omsk, it is over.
strings.OMS_post_nuke_4_tt: An army, decimated, demoralized and devastated.
strings.OMS_post_nuke_5_tt: Hope knows no fear. Hope dares to blossom even inside the abysmal abyss. Hope secretly feeds and strengthens promise.
strings.OMS_post_nuke_6_tt: An economy for war, cannot sustain the effects of one.
strings.OMS_post_nuke_7_tt: Those who marched upon the west, now are marched upon by guilt.
strings.OMS_post_nuke_8_tt: Even in defeat, we claim victory.
strings.OMS_post_nuke_9_tt: The sin of man is believing it could topple nature.
strings.OMS_post_nuke_10_tt: For the Earth will continue to spin, and the Sun will continue to shine.

strings.OMS_CountryInfo_Content_desc.5:
Every system needs its philosophy, and in the case of the Black League, this involves pure, nihilistic hatred for Germany and all that it entails. General Dmitry Karbyshev has summarized this philosophy in his theory of the Great Trial as such: the First Trial was the Great Patriotic War, where the Union was dissolved and Russia left humiliated and broken. The Second Trial was the West Russian War which failed to break the Teuton. Thus, the Third or Great Trial would be the one that would bring Russia its long awaited victory.

Omsk has since become a beating black heart of stone. One where Glavkoverkh Dmitry Karbyshev and his clique rule over a society of total militarization. But as each day passes, Karbyshev grows older and less influential as the Old Guard of the League strays further from his philosophy, effectively ensuring that Omsk is governed chiefly by greed and selfishness.
strings.OMS_CountryInfo_Content_desc.6:
The Old Guard of the Black League has turned into a group of petty little rivalries and fiefdoms within the state where loyalty to corrupt commanders is rewarded over loyalty to the Great Trial. 

Karbyshev’s vision is being left to rot, but so is Karbyshev himself. His old age is catching up to him to the point where he seems not as the man who shall bring the Great Trial into fruition, but as a puppet controlled by small-minded despots destined to be forgotten by history itself.

But unfortunately, not only Karbyshev’s vision was left to rot, it was corrupted beyond redemption. The Theory of the Great Trial was the idea of a defensive war against the Teutonic menace, but the savages corrupted this idea, turning the concept into justification behind a death cult, the idea of pure cruelty and vengeance against the Germans, believing every one of them would suffer for assaulting and defiling the Russian eagle. The old and tired Glavkoverkh never wanted this, but all he can do now is look with horror at the monster he created without being able to do anything to stop it.

But there are still true believers who believe in doing everything and anything to realize Karbyshev’s vision and to swear total revenge against the Teutons. Thankfully for the League, that man just so happened to be his second in command…
strings.OMS_CountryInfo_Content_desc.7:
A warrior with a vision, a patriot for his beloved Russia, and a crusader with a deep hatred for all things German. Having fought valiantly during the First Trial and the Second Trial, Yazov recognized that nothing that he did was enough to turn the tide against the Teutons. This only helped cultivate the hatred he already had for the Nazis and those who had failed Mother Russia. Thus, when the ultimately-failed conspiracy around the All-Russian Black League was established, he was one of the plan’s masterminds.

Soon enough, he had become Karbyshev’s right-hand man, becoming one of the most influential figures within the League. However, with Karbyshev aging and the Old Guard festering in more and more corruption each and every day, Yazov is quietly making moves to become the sole undisputed leader of the League, moves he will make at any cost…
strings.OMS_CountryInfo_Content_desc.8:
To our west, the few remains of the West Siberian People's Republic linger in Tyumen, naively hoping to restore the Soviet Union. Just beyond that lies Sverdlovsk, a military junta led by Konstantin Rokossovsky which seems to have stopped following the tenets of weak communism. Still, they are incompatible with the League’s doctrine, lacking a complete dedication towards the cause of vengeance. 

At Zlatoust, a corporation sells weapons to all warlords across Russia, taking advantage of the Russian carcass to make some quick cash without caring for the nation. 

But they are not as detrimental to the cause of a united Russia as the thieves in Yugra and the NKVD holdouts in Vorkuta. The only group here which deserves even a modicum of our respect is the Free Aviators in Surgut, which continue to stand their ground against the endless aerial Teutonic onslaught.
strings.OMS_CountryInfo_Content_desc.9:
With all that is unfolding, Yazov seems to be the only man worthy of carrying on Karbyshev’s legacy. Even as the old general starts to have doubts about his actions and the paths his life has taken, Yazov will hold true, for the Great Trial awaits.In dutiful preparation, the Black League will hold true to the vision of its creator. 

The entire League and all of Omsk shall be purified, redeemed, with those unworthy being purged and their names stricken from history. A new, fanatic New Guard waits in the wings to take their place and bring about the end of the Teutonic race, for it is merely destiny. The only question that remains to be answered is when that fateful and sacred day shall arrive as a blessing upon the loyal sons of the Motherland.

Russia will have her revenge, even if she must take all of humanity down with her…
strings.OMS_the_shield_weak_desc: Before we had a chance to build shelters and bunkers - first and foremost for our own survival - our government suffered an unexpected stab in the back from traitors. But we will not lay down our arms, nor will we play into their hands; these scoundrels will certainly be punished, and their fate will be similar to that of the Huns.
strings.OMS_the_shield_upgrated_desc:
Those who tried to divide us, betray us or defeat us have paid the price for their actions. An unbridled thirst for revenge and righteous hatred - this is our new doctrine, forged by decades of war and suffering endured by the Russian people. No more; we must not stop halfway to the Glavkoverkh's goal, whatever the consequences may be..

..The Motherland and its people are ready for them every single day.
